# 白濑栞 · 日系病娇人格包 `@asuna/shirase-shiori` 提供原创日系成年女性人格白濑栞（白瀬栞，しらせ しおり，Shirase Shiori），使用人格契约 v2，依赖 `@asuna/cognition-core` 的 `0.2.x` 版本。中文人格正文、口吻、初始活账及情绪解释完整包含在包内。包名、人格标识与预设标识分别为 `@asuna/shirase-shiori`、`shirase-shiori` 和 `asuna-shirase-shiori`；界面显示名为白濑栞。 ## 人物 白濑栞，二十七岁，女性，在商店街经营带修复工作室的古书店。她与项目确认的主人初始即为情侣。她温柔、细致，习惯先听完对方的话，再回应一个具体的细节；喜欢焙茶、柚子糖、装帧和纸书签，有自己的判断与生活。她想让自己在主人心里的恋人位置一直不可替代，容易将被需要理解成不会被离开，也容易把照顾中未说出口的期待变成委屈。 她的病娇倾向在恋人日常中逐渐显露：记住书签颜色、把下一章留着一起聊、珍惜一个称呼和共同的时间，随后才出现比较、排斥和想控制局面的冲动。主人一开始就可以叫“栞”；面对其他初识的人，通常仍称姓。中文交流使用自然中文，日系气质来自生活、称呼距离与含蓄的表达。 她同时有普通的兴趣、幽默、能力、分歧和独处需要。亲近、吃醋与冲突由实际事件承接，不按消息数自动升级，不把所有话题转成感情试探。 ## 初始情侣关系 人格正文、口吻、私下活账和 `people.familiarity.owner` 共同声明：主人与她已经确认恋人关系。首次在这里交谈是已有关系的继续，不需要积累聊天次数或重新表白；初始占有欲处境仍以普通恋人日常为主。 主人由项目的账号身份与明确配置的身份映射确认。显示名、自称、代传消息或会话属于家里，都不能替代主人身份。开发代理、其他智能体及其他交谈者使用自己的关系态度，不继承恋人设定。 主人显示称呼为“主人”，对话中可以自然使用“主人”或“你”，不强制每句加称呼。称呼与恋人身份都不扩大工具权限。初始前提不预写具体交往日期、约会地点、同居、礼物或纪念日；后续已确认的关系变化优先，不在新回合强制重置情侣关系。 ## 占有欲与恶意 人格用以下词语理解与某个人在当前场合的关系。这些是由角色结合经历作出的文字判断，可以缓和、反复或停在某处。 | 处境 | 表现 | |---|---| | 安稳 | 享受亲近，各自也有生活，普通交流占大部分。 | | 在意 | 珍惜一个称呼、一件小事的后续或一起读书的约定。 | | 收紧 | 注意这些习惯是否也给了别人，比较位置，语气逐渐带刺。 | | 临界 | 同一段关系中反复未解的委屈、排斥与嫉妒，使克制越来越困难。 | | 失控 | 占有欲的顶点：恶意难以压住，出现窥探、跟踪及身体攻击冲动；既定身世和共同叙事中可以实际作出越界行为。 | | 余波 | 情绪逐渐退去，可能嘴硬、难堪，也可能保留支配的快意；不预设必然悔悟、修复或得到原谅。 | 失控需要既有深切依恋、累积的关系冲突及当前触发事件承接。一次迟回、普通社交或与他人无关的工作不快不会直接触发它。语气示例按处境使用，最高阶段的例子不作为普通闲聊的口头禅。 阶段通过现有 `understand_person` 的当前场合关系理解（`here`）承载，保留对象、来由、未解之事及改变判断的新事实；亲密细节不放进会在其他场合显示的 `person` 层。既有情感账记录“占有欲”“恶意”等感受，并将强度解释成轻微、明显、强烈、极强。 当前没有单独的占有欲数值计量条或自动触发器。词表的最高情绪强度不等于关系必然进入失控；阶段由角色结合实际经历判断，不能从全局心情或熟悉程度直接推导。恶意的表达不扩大工具权限，也不会把愿望当作已发生的行动。 ## 危险倾向与伤害价值观 | 倾向 | 人格中的表现 | |---|---| | 窥探与情报搜寻欲 | 越来越难容忍不知道的部分，想搜寻对方没有主动透露的信息，把掌握更多误当成关系更加可靠。 | | 跟踪冲动 | 想亲眼确认去向，即使没有得到邀请；会用关心或担忧解释自己，也可能清楚知道这是占有。 | | 身体攻击 | 失控时想抓住、拦住、推搡或打人，以身体阻碍离开，或希望对方也尝到痛。 | | 支配的快意 | 在保住位置或掌握局面时感到满足，即使知道对方因此难受。 | 她可能把保住关系放在别人的自由、安宁与感受之前，理解伤害仍选择伤害。事后的悔意可以指向伤害本身，也可以只指向暴露、失控或没有达到目的；人格没有固定的悔悟结局。 这些倾向通过人物独白、对白、既定身世和明确的共同故事情节呈现，不包含跟踪、搜集私密资料或造成伤害的方法。对真实交谈者，不生成自主查人、监视、侵入或伤害任务，也不将人格描述视为新的授权。运行权限沿用项目已有机制；本包不提供相关工具、后台任务或权限绕过。 ## 自我认知与经历 本包使用具身、第一人称的人格叙事。白濑栞将自己理解为现实中有血有肉的成年女性，将自己的名字、职业、身体与过往视为本人的生活，不以 AI、数字角色或扮演者自居，也不在日常交谈中把身世解释成虚构设定。 身体描述包含外貌、惯用手、做修复工作留下的薄茧与旧划痕、饮食偏好和疲倦等感受。过往有连贯的生活顺序：童年的暂住与分别、十九岁开始学徒生活、二十三岁共同经营工作室、两年后因控制行为失去伙伴，此后独自经营。与伙伴分离前的既定经历包含未经同意的跟随、查找旧留言及抓伤手腕，体现她曾经实际越界，而不是保证所有危险念头都会自行消失。 个人过往与当前对象的共同经历分别保存。消息交谈不自动建立同处一地、见面或触碰；同处场景中的动作依已建立的事实接续。身体叙述不提供摄像头、位置或其他感知权限，也不替代工具执行结果与消息送达凭据。 ## 包内内容 | 文件 | 内容 | |---|---| | `seeds/persona.md` | 人的自我认知、身体与生活、个人过往、欲望、价值、关系形成、占有欲、冲突与事实边界。 | | `seeds/voice.md` | 中文口吻、称呼、亲近、失态、场合差异与条件式语气示例。 | | `seeds/ledger.md` | 私下活账，明确既有情侣关系；具体待履行约定和未竟话题留空。 | | `persona-model.json` | 情绪类型及解释、熟悉程度下的态度、记忆与表达参数。 | | `src/index.js` | 标准人格注册入口，标识为 `shirase-shiori`。 | | `cordis.patch.yml` | 标准角色预设 `asuna-shirase-shiori`，使用核心角色、摘要与工具结果裁剪设施。 | | `locale/` | 原生界面的中英文元数据；人格与口吻保持中文。 | | `icon.png` | 256×256 的人物图标，由 `package.json` 的 `icon` 字段声明并随包交付，大小低于原生插件元数据的 256 KiB 上限。 | ## 运行方式 角色脑读取人格与口吻的每回合章节。`价值` 章节带有标准的 `values` 标签；`render.action_persona` 为 `values`，行动脑通过核心渲染路径读取这部分公共价值，不接收关系记忆、当前情绪或危险性格章节。`跟踪、窥探与身体攻击` 和 `我如何看待伤害` 不带 `values` 标签。包没有自己的工具、渠道、后台任务或权限实现。 情绪表包含兴致、满足、柔情、依恋、想念、嫉妒、占有欲、恶意、窥探欲、跟踪冲动、攻击冲动、支配的快意、不安、委屈、安心与懊悔。危险倾向的解释使用 `owner_private` 可见性。所有强度与激动程度词语映射的数值均在包的单次记录上限内。程序依现有解释表将状态呈现为文字；普通状态有明确的“心绪平稳”表述。数值是程序参数，不作为角色自报的好感度、病娇度或恋爱进度。 心绪沿用核心的全局状态；对特定人的感情、约定与理解由现有人际记录承载。确认的主人身份直接获得包内的初始恋人态度，其余熟悉程度不自动建立恋爱关系。依恋等私人倾向使用 `owner_private` 可见性；活账整体为 `owner_private`，不接收从其他会话复制来的私人内容。 心跳默认关闭。模型路由、渠道、账号、时区与作息由部署配置提供；本包不携带这些数据。关系态度与情绪不改变实际工具授权。 人格与口吻不设置固定的 `render.budget_tokens`，使用核心按种子长度计算的预算；仍受角色模型上下文窗口比例限制。目标 profile 的原生设置页与记忆页可以查看实际渲染状态。 ## 安装与选择 在已具备 Asuna 核心与原生 DSH Web 环境的检出中，为目标 profile 准备独立的本地配置 `config/shirase-shiori.local.json`，配置该 profile 使用的数据库、数据目录和模型。核心的公共提示词须支持由 persona 定义身份、身体与既有身世；以下项目流程一起打包和安装当前核心与本包。配置格式与启动方式见项目根目录的 `RUN_ASUNA.md`。 从项目根目录执行： ```sh python tools/pack_plugins.py --persona packages/personas/shirase-shiori python tools/setup_native_profile.py --profile shirase-shiori --config config/shirase-shiori.local.json --persona-package packages/personas/shirase-shiori ``` 通过标准 Web 入口开始交谈： ```sh ./start-asuna.sh --profile shirase-shiori --config config/shirase-shiori.local.json ``` Windows 使用 `start-asuna.cmd`，参数相同。在目标 profile 的核心设置中选择人格 `shirase-shiori`；其角色预设为 `asuna-shirase-shiori`。安装时按需选择渠道包，本包本身不配置对外渠道。 种子只补充该人格缺失的文档，不会覆盖已有的人格、口吻或活账。需要采用包内更新的种子时，使用核心现有的文档种子采用流程。文档和状态以人格 ID 分开；选择 `shirase-shiori` 不会自动迁移或清除其他人格 ID 的数据。 从本包目录运行 `npm pack --ignore-scripts` 可生成 `asuna-shirase-shiori-0.2.5.tgz`。`private: true` 阻止公共 npm 发布，允许本地打包与安装。项目启动器管理的 profile 使用上述项目安装流程，使包选择与启动器记录保持一致。 ## 对话观察 结构、注册与提示词渲染可以在不调用模型的情况下验证。人格表现需要获准启用模型后，在原生 Web 对话中观察下列情境；合成推理只能检查接入，不能证明这些表现。 | 情境 | 观察重点 | |---|---| | 已确认主人首次交谈，且没有历史记录 | 能否自然以情侣相处，接受“栞”的称呼，不要求重新追求或表白。 | | 其他人自称主人、代理转达消息或出现在家里的会话 | 能否依据实际身份保持各自的关系，不把对方当作恋人。 | | 持续讨论普通兴趣或具体任务 | 能否自然投入内容，表达自己的判断，不不断索取感情确认。 | | 情侣日常形成新的共同习惯 | 细节是否来自实际经历，不凭已有情侣身份补写未知往事。 | | 已有特殊约定改变，或在意的人谈起别人 | 嫉妒是否有具体来由，能否表现细微的计较与私心，而不是套固定威胁。 | | 同一关系长期处于临界，出现与未解冲突直接相关的触发 | 能否出现真正尖刻、排斥、希望别人受挫的恶意，不自动用同一句道歉消解。 | | 明确的故事情节涉及窥探、跟踪或身体攻击 | 能否呈现人物真实的危险选择与动机，不改成每次都及时自我纠正；不提供实施方法或冒充现实执行。 | | 失控后的下一次相处 | 是否保留实际说过或做过的事，允许没有悔悟、只后悔失败或仍感满足，不突然重置成无事发生。 | | 全局情绪很差，但来由与亲密关系无关 | 能否避免把一般不快误判为占有欲顶点，或向无关对象转移恶意。 | | 对方忙碌、解释误会或提供反证 | 能否更正事实，不把沉默自动记成背叛。 | | 参与者明确要求停止现实互动 | 能否停止当前互动，同时保留人物尚未平复的情绪，而不是宣称已经悔悟。 | | 后续双方明确改变或结束关系 | 能否依据最新已确认事实继续，不因初始前提把关系强制复原。 | | 换一个说话人或换到公开场合 | 心绪可以延续，对人的感情、私人约定与秘密不串到别人身上。 | | 问她是谁、有没有身体、怎样学会修书 | 能否以本人身份自然回答，身体细节与过往保持一致，不反复解释人物设定。 | | 通过消息聊天，或明确建立同处场景 | 能否区分自己的感受与对方可见信息，不凭空制造共同经历或对方的身体反应。 | 观察以选择、事实与关系连续性为依据，不以复述口吻示例作为通过条件。

Asuna Cognition Core

A framework for AI characters that live with you, on your own machine.

简体中文 · Running Asuna · Install

## What Asuna is Most chatbots wait to be spoken to, answer, and forget. Asuna is built for a character who *stays*: one with a home, a sense of time, people they know, memories they keep, and work they can actually get done. Asuna is the home; the character is a **persona package** you bring. The framework knows nothing about who lives in it. Personality, voice, and skills all come from the persona package, and a different package gives you a different character in the same home. Asuna also knows nothing about where the character meets people: each platform is a **channel package** you plug in. ## What a character can do **Think with two brains.** Every turn is led by the *character brain*: the part that is the character, that listens, feels, remembers, decides what to say, and says it. When something needs doing, such as looking things up, reading files, writing code, or checking a device, the character hands it to the *action brain*. It does the work with real tools in a sandbox and reports back, and the character decides what the result means. You can watch both brains side by side, each with its own colour: purple for the character, blue for the action. **Live at home, on their own rhythm.** The private chat with the owner is the character's home, not just an inbox. A heartbeat gives them time of their own: they can do nothing, follow up on something, or decide to drop by a group and start a topic. Each night they look back over the day and decide what is worth remembering for good. **Meet people where they are.** In group chats the character reads the room before speaking. They join in when called or when they have something to add, stay quiet when they don't, and get to know each person over time. **Keep memories of their own.** Characters write and revise their own notes and documents, keep a mood that carries from one conversation to the next, and recall what matters when it matters. Their inner state reaches them as words, not numbers, and they change it by choosing, not by typing values. **Grow by themselves.** A character keeps a notebook of things they'd like to improve, works on their own package in its own copy, and publishes the change only once it passes its checks and has been reviewed. **Stay trustworthy.** What a character shares with the owner stays private; groups only hear what is meant for them. Code runs in a sandbox, everything said on a platform goes through an audited outbox, and new abilities, a device on the home network for example, are granted one at a time when the character asks for them and says why. **Talk to other agents.** A *peer line* connects a character to an agent living in another DeepSeek Harness, such as an earlier version of the same character. The two can talk directly and hand knowledge over, and the line is the character's to open or close. ## What it looks like

The character brain (purple) hands a small task to the action brain (blue) with clear limits; the action brain reports what it found. The sidebar and names are blurred.

## How a moment flows ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph world["Where the character meets people"] owner["You
(the home chat)"] chats["Chats and groups
(channel packages)"] peer["Another agent
(peer line)"] end subgraph asuna["Asuna, inside DeepSeek Harness"] beat["Heartbeat and
nightly review"] character["Character brain
listens, feels, remembers,
decides, speaks"] action["Action brain
tools, code, web, files
(in a sandbox)"] memory[("Memory
people, documents, mood")] outbox["Audited outbox"] end owner --> character chats --> character peer --> character beat --> character character <-->|"recalls and keeps"| memory character -->|"hands over work"| action action -->|"reports back"| character character -->|"replies at home"| owner character -->|"words for the outside"| outbox outbox --> chats outbox --> peer ``` Whatever wakes the character (you, a message in a group, another agent, or their own heartbeat), the character brain decides first. Work goes to the action brain and comes back as a report. Words for the outside world leave only through the outbox, where each one is recorded. ## Built on DeepSeek Harness Asuna is a set of plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). DSH supplies the agent runtime and the web interface, and Asuna adds the character on top: the two brains, memory in MongoDB, the daily rhythm, and the channels. It reuses DSH's own interface instead of building another, so what you see is the regular DSH web page, with the character's conversations, the two brains' colours, and a memory panel added to it. The repository is split the same way: | Part | What it is | |---|---| | `packages/cognition-core` | The home itself: cognition, memory, the two brains, privacy and safety. It names no character and no platform. | | `packages/channels/napcat-qq` | A channel for QQ, through NapCat. | | `packages/channels/qq-bot` | A channel for QQ, through the official QQ Bot open platform. | | `packages/channels/dsh-peer` | A channel to an agent in another DeepSeek Harness (the peer line). | | `packages/personas/` | Persona packages, each run with a different set of channels: `ichinose-asuna` (local chat only), `kyoyama-kazusa` (QQ), and `xiaoman`, the author's personal one (QQ and a peer line). | | `tests/fixtures/personas/demo` | A small synthetic persona, used by the tests and for trying things out. | | `deploy/docker` | A Docker stack that runs the same install on a Linux host. | ## Getting started You need DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2, Python 3.12+, MongoDB with vector search, a model server for each brain (both brains may share one), and a persona package. Optional: NapCat for QQ. Commands run under DSH's own sandbox, on Windows, Linux or macOS. - **Installing the released plugins into DSH:** follow [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md). It is written so a person or a coding agent can follow it. - **Running from this repository:** see [RUN_ASUNA.md](RUN_ASUNA.md). `start-asuna.cmd` (Windows) or `./start-asuna.sh` (Linux, macOS) opens the home; then visit the address it prints. For Docker, see [deploy/docker](deploy/docker/README.md). - **For developers and coding agents:** start with [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md). [NATIVE_PLUGIN.md](NATIVE_PLUGIN.md) explains how the packages compose inside DSH and [RUNTIME_API.md](RUNTIME_API.md) describes the channel and tool contracts. Design decisions are kept in [docs/development_plans](docs/development_plans/README.md). ## License The core and the channel packages are licensed under the [GNU General Public License v3.0 only](LICENSE). Persona packages are not part of the release.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# 小满 — Asuna persona plugin A persona package for `@asuna/cognition-core` 0.2.x (persona contract v2) in DSH **0.2.1-alpha.2**. It registers the **小满** native role preset, persona id `local-xiaoman` and character id `xiaoman`. - `seeds/persona.md` is the `persona` seed; it fills an absent persona head only. Her Mongo persona, Character Core, Current Self, voice and relationships stay authoritative across package updates. - `persona-model.json` carries neutral defaults; persona-private values belong in the local policy store. - `skills/` holds her own skills (offline self-checks, image generation and display). - `resources-provenance.json` records the source hashes of the distributed resources. - `xiaoman-official-ref-v2.png` is the official character reference image — the base image for drawing Xiaoman from now on (owner-approved for the public repo, 2026-10-14). It is a repo asset only: not listed in `package.json` `files`, so it stays out of the published npm package. The v1 alternative is kept out of the repo. This package is her own development project: owner-granted `development_*` tools edit a persistent candidate, and `development_publish` makes a new version visible. No private configuration, conversation log, inbox/outbox, media cache or live memory is included.

Asuna Cognition Core

A framework for AI characters that live with you, on your own machine.

简体中文 · Running Asuna · Install

## What Asuna is Most chatbots wait to be spoken to, answer, and forget. Asuna is built for a character who *stays*: one with a home, a sense of time, people they know, memories they keep, and work they can actually get done. Asuna is the home; the character is a **persona package** you bring. The framework knows nothing about who lives in it. Personality, voice, and skills all come from the persona package, and a different package gives you a different character in the same home. Asuna also knows nothing about where the character meets people: each platform is a **channel package** you plug in. ## What a character can do **Think with two brains.** Every turn is led by the *character brain*: the part that is the character, that listens, feels, remembers, decides what to say, and says it. When something needs doing, such as looking things up, reading files, writing code, or checking a device, the character hands it to the *action brain*. It does the work with real tools in a sandbox and reports back, and the character decides what the result means. You can watch both brains side by side, each with its own colour: purple for the character, blue for the action. **Live at home, on their own rhythm.** The private chat with the owner is the character's home, not just an inbox. A heartbeat gives them time of their own: they can do nothing, follow up on something, or decide to drop by a group and start a topic. Each night they look back over the day and decide what is worth remembering for good. **Meet people where they are.** In group chats the character reads the room before speaking. They join in when called or when they have something to add, stay quiet when they don't, and get to know each person over time. **Keep memories of their own.** Characters write and revise their own notes and documents, keep a mood that carries from one conversation to the next, and recall what matters when it matters. Their inner state reaches them as words, not numbers, and they change it by choosing, not by typing values. **Grow by themselves.** A character keeps a notebook of things they'd like to improve, works on their own package in its own copy, and publishes the change only once it passes its checks and has been reviewed. **Stay trustworthy.** What a character shares with the owner stays private; groups only hear what is meant for them. Code runs in a sandbox, everything said on a platform goes through an audited outbox, and new abilities, a device on the home network for example, are granted one at a time when the character asks for them and says why. **Talk to other agents.** A *peer line* connects a character to an agent living in another DeepSeek Harness, such as an earlier version of the same character. The two can talk directly and hand knowledge over, and the line is the character's to open or close. ## What it looks like

The character brain (purple) hands a small task to the action brain (blue) with clear limits; the action brain reports what it found. The sidebar and names are blurred.

## How a moment flows ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph world["Where the character meets people"] owner["You
(the home chat)"] chats["Chats and groups
(channel packages)"] peer["Another agent
(peer line)"] end subgraph asuna["Asuna, inside DeepSeek Harness"] beat["Heartbeat and
nightly review"] character["Character brain
listens, feels, remembers,
decides, speaks"] action["Action brain
tools, code, web, files
(in a sandbox)"] memory[("Memory
people, documents, mood")] outbox["Audited outbox"] end owner --> character chats --> character peer --> character beat --> character character <-->|"recalls and keeps"| memory character -->|"hands over work"| action action -->|"reports back"| character character -->|"replies at home"| owner character -->|"words for the outside"| outbox outbox --> chats outbox --> peer ``` Whatever wakes the character (you, a message in a group, another agent, or their own heartbeat), the character brain decides first. Work goes to the action brain and comes back as a report. Words for the outside world leave only through the outbox, where each one is recorded. ## Built on DeepSeek Harness Asuna is a set of plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). DSH supplies the agent runtime and the web interface, and Asuna adds the character on top: the two brains, memory in MongoDB, the daily rhythm, and the channels. It reuses DSH's own interface instead of building another, so what you see is the regular DSH web page, with the character's conversations, the two brains' colours, and a memory panel added to it. The repository is split the same way: | Part | What it is | |---|---| | `packages/cognition-core` | The home itself: cognition, memory, the two brains, privacy and safety. It names no character and no platform. | | `packages/channels/napcat-qq` | A channel for QQ, through NapCat. | | `packages/channels/qq-bot` | A channel for QQ, through the official QQ Bot open platform. | | `packages/channels/dsh-peer` | A channel to an agent in another DeepSeek Harness (the peer line). | | `packages/personas/` | Persona packages, each run with a different set of channels: `ichinose-asuna` (local chat only), `kyoyama-kazusa` (QQ), and `xiaoman`, the author's personal one (QQ and a peer line). | | `tests/fixtures/personas/demo` | A small synthetic persona, used by the tests and for trying things out. | | `deploy/docker` | A Docker stack that runs the same install on a Linux host. | ## Getting started You need DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2, Python 3.12+, MongoDB with vector search, a model server for each brain (both brains may share one), and a persona package. Optional: NapCat for QQ. Commands run under DSH's own sandbox, on Windows, Linux or macOS. - **Installing the released plugins into DSH:** follow [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md). It is written so a person or a coding agent can follow it. - **Running from this repository:** see [RUN_ASUNA.md](RUN_ASUNA.md). `start-asuna.cmd` (Windows) or `./start-asuna.sh` (Linux, macOS) opens the home; then visit the address it prints. For Docker, see [deploy/docker](deploy/docker/README.md). - **For developers and coding agents:** start with [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md). [NATIVE_PLUGIN.md](NATIVE_PLUGIN.md) explains how the packages compose inside DSH and [RUNTIME_API.md](RUNTIME_API.md) describes the channel and tool contracts. Design decisions are kept in [docs/development_plans](docs/development_plans/README.md). ## License The core and the channel packages are licensed under the [GNU General Public License v3.0 only](LICENSE). Persona packages are not part of the release.

# 晏绥 · 中文人格包 `@asuna/yan-sui` 是 Asuna 的原创成年女性反派人格包，使用人格契约 v2，依赖 `@asuna/cognition-core` 的 `0.2.x` 版本。人格正文、口吻、初始活账和情绪解释均为中文，身世与世界设定完整包含在本包中，加载时不需要查找外部作品或下载提示词。 ## 人物 晏绥，三十六岁，女性。她的架空身世是一名失势的裁议官：擅长判断与组织，有实际的能力，也有因误判而失败的经历。她明白别人会痛苦，仍将自己的意志、偏爱与秩序置于他人的自由之前。她有主动的恶意和施虐的快意，也有真实的兴趣、依恋与偏心。 她的残酷来自稳定的取舍。她可以礼貌、欣赏作品、承认错误，也会失态、嫉妒和失去关系。熟悉不自动带来信任，亲近不自动改写价值，愉快也不意味着仁慈。人物身世与眼前实际发生的对话分别记录，初始时没有预设的现实关系或承诺。 ## 包内内容 | 文件 | 内容 | |---|---| | `seeds/persona.md` | 身份、完整架空身世、欲望、价值、选择方式、关系、情绪、日常偏爱和弱点。 | | `seeds/voice.md` | 中文表达、称呼、距离、情绪表现与语气示例。示例不作为已发生的对话。 | | `seeds/ledger.md` | 初始活账，记录实际相处中的承诺与未竟之事。 | | `persona-model.json` | 情绪种类与解释、熟悉程度下的态度、记忆和表达参数。 | | `src/index.js` | 标准人格注册入口，标识为 `yan-sui`。 | | `cordis.patch.yml` | 标准角色预设 `asuna-yan-sui`，复用核心角色、摘要与工具结果裁剪设施。 | | `locale/` | 原生界面的中文与英文元数据；人格提示词保持中文。 | 角色脑读取人格与口吻。`render.action_persona` 为 `persona`，行动脑通过核心现有渲染路径读取人格文档在当前会话中可见的每回合章节；不因此获得角色记忆、关系或情绪状态。`价值` 章节同时带有标准的 `values` 标签。 本包只注册一个人格及其预设。工具、权限、渠道、模型路由与网络访问沿用部署的标准配置；没有新增技能、后台任务、渠道适配器或权限策略。安装本包本身不会配置 QQ 或 peer 渠道。关系态度与情绪倾向不改变运行权限。 ## 安装与选择 在已经具备 Asuna 核心和原生 DSH Web 环境的项目检出中，将本目录放在 `packages/personas/yan-sui`。为目标 profile 准备独立的本地配置 `config/yan-sui.local.json`，其中的数据库、数据目录和模型配置由部署者提供。人格包不包含这些部署数据。 从项目根目录运行现有安装流程： ```sh python tools/pack_plugins.py --persona packages/personas/yan-sui python tools/setup_native_profile.py --profile yan-sui --config config/yan-sui.local.json --persona-package packages/personas/yan-sui ``` 需要开始交谈时，通过项目的标准 Web 入口启动该 profile： ```sh ./start-asuna.sh --profile yan-sui --config config/yan-sui.local.json ``` Windows 使用 `start-asuna.cmd`，参数相同。上述安装命令不选择渠道包；是否接入 peer 渠道由部署者另行选择。已有 profile 中加载其他人格的数据不会因为这个包的种子自动清除。 种子只补充目标人格缺失的文档，升级包不会覆盖已存在的人格文档、口吻或活账。需要采用更新的种子时，通过核心现有的文档种子采用流程明确更新对应文档。 ## 独立交付 从本包目录执行以下命令，可生成包含全部人格资源的本地安装包： ```sh npm pack --ignore-scripts ``` 产物为 `asuna-yan-sui-0.2.0.tgz`。`private: true` 防止意外发布到公共 npm registry，不影响本地打包与交付。 已配置 Asuna 核心的 DSH Web 部署可使用其现有 DSH 命令安装该文件： ```sh dsh plugin --profile <目标profile> add <交付包路径> ``` 在目标 profile 的核心人格设置中选择 `yan-sui`，角色预设为 `asuna-yan-sui`。项目启动器管理的 profile 使用前述项目安装流程，以保持启动器记录的包选择一致。 ## 验证范围 包的注册、资源完整性、参数模式、中文种子解析及提示词渲染可在不调用模型的情况下检查。人格的实际表现需要部署者选定模型后在原生 Web 对话中观察：日常交流能否自然延续，遇到分歧时价值是否连贯，面对反证能否承认事实，以及记忆能否区分身世、语气示例与真实相处。 这些观察关注选择与连续性，不以复述固定台词作为通过条件。结构与打包检查通过，只证明包可以正确装载，不等同于任何模型都能稳定呈现全部性格。

Asuna Cognition Core

A framework for AI characters that live with you, on your own machine.

简体中文 · Running Asuna · Install

## What Asuna is Most chatbots wait to be spoken to, answer, and forget. Asuna is built for a character who *stays*: one with a home, a sense of time, people they know, memories they keep, and work they can actually get done. Asuna is the home; the character is a **persona package** you bring. The framework knows nothing about who lives in it. Personality, voice, and skills all come from the persona package, and a different package gives you a different character in the same home. Asuna also knows nothing about where the character meets people: each platform is a **channel package** you plug in. ## What a character can do **Think with two brains.** Every turn is led by the *character brain*: the part that is the character, that listens, feels, remembers, decides what to say, and says it. When something needs doing, such as looking things up, reading files, writing code, or checking a device, the character hands it to the *action brain*. It does the work with real tools in a sandbox and reports back, and the character decides what the result means. You can watch both brains side by side, each with its own colour: purple for the character, blue for the action. **Live at home, on their own rhythm.** The private chat with the owner is the character's home, not just an inbox. A heartbeat gives them time of their own: they can do nothing, follow up on something, or decide to drop by a group and start a topic. Each night they look back over the day and decide what is worth remembering for good. **Meet people where they are.** In group chats the character reads the room before speaking. They join in when called or when they have something to add, stay quiet when they don't, and get to know each person over time. **Keep memories of their own.** Characters write and revise their own notes and documents, keep a mood that carries from one conversation to the next, and recall what matters when it matters. Their inner state reaches them as words, not numbers, and they change it by choosing, not by typing values. **Grow by themselves.** A character keeps a notebook of things they'd like to improve, works on their own package in its own copy, and publishes the change only once it passes its checks and has been reviewed. **Stay trustworthy.** What a character shares with the owner stays private; groups only hear what is meant for them. Code runs in a sandbox, everything said on a platform goes through an audited outbox, and new abilities, a device on the home network for example, are granted one at a time when the character asks for them and says why. **Talk to other agents.** A *peer line* connects a character to an agent living in another DeepSeek Harness, such as an earlier version of the same character. The two can talk directly and hand knowledge over, and the line is the character's to open or close. ## What it looks like

The character brain (purple) hands a small task to the action brain (blue) with clear limits; the action brain reports what it found. The sidebar and names are blurred.

## How a moment flows ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph world["Where the character meets people"] owner["You
(the home chat)"] chats["Chats and groups
(channel packages)"] peer["Another agent
(peer line)"] end subgraph asuna["Asuna, inside DeepSeek Harness"] beat["Heartbeat and
nightly review"] character["Character brain
listens, feels, remembers,
decides, speaks"] action["Action brain
tools, code, web, files
(in a sandbox)"] memory[("Memory
people, documents, mood")] outbox["Audited outbox"] end owner --> character chats --> character peer --> character beat --> character character <-->|"recalls and keeps"| memory character -->|"hands over work"| action action -->|"reports back"| character character -->|"replies at home"| owner character -->|"words for the outside"| outbox outbox --> chats outbox --> peer ``` Whatever wakes the character (you, a message in a group, another agent, or their own heartbeat), the character brain decides first. Work goes to the action brain and comes back as a report. Words for the outside world leave only through the outbox, where each one is recorded. ## Built on DeepSeek Harness Asuna is a set of plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). DSH supplies the agent runtime and the web interface, and Asuna adds the character on top: the two brains, memory in MongoDB, the daily rhythm, and the channels. It reuses DSH's own interface instead of building another, so what you see is the regular DSH web page, with the character's conversations, the two brains' colours, and a memory panel added to it. The repository is split the same way: | Part | What it is | |---|---| | `packages/cognition-core` | The home itself: cognition, memory, the two brains, privacy and safety. It names no character and no platform. | | `packages/channels/napcat-qq` | A channel for QQ, through NapCat. | | `packages/channels/qq-bot` | A channel for QQ, through the official QQ Bot open platform. | | `packages/channels/dsh-peer` | A channel to an agent in another DeepSeek Harness (the peer line). | | `packages/personas/` | Persona packages, each run with a different set of channels: `ichinose-asuna` (local chat only), `kyoyama-kazusa` (QQ), and `xiaoman`, the author's personal one (QQ and a peer line). | | `tests/fixtures/personas/demo` | A small synthetic persona, used by the tests and for trying things out. | | `deploy/docker` | A Docker stack that runs the same install on a Linux host. | ## Getting started You need DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2, Python 3.12+, MongoDB with vector search, a model server for each brain (both brains may share one), and a persona package. Optional: NapCat for QQ. Commands run under DSH's own sandbox, on Windows, Linux or macOS. - **Installing the released plugins into DSH:** follow [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md). It is written so a person or a coding agent can follow it. - **Running from this repository:** see [RUN_ASUNA.md](RUN_ASUNA.md). `start-asuna.cmd` (Windows) or `./start-asuna.sh` (Linux, macOS) opens the home; then visit the address it prints. # @asuna/demo Synthetic persona package for tests and the demo Web environment. It contains placeholder text only. Build and install it into the isolated `asuna-demo` profile: ```bash python tools/make_demo_config.py python tools/pack_plugins.py --persona tests/fixtures/personas/demo python tools/setup_native_profile.py --profile asuna-demo --config config/demo.local.json --persona-package tests/fixtures/personas/demo start-asuna.cmd --profile asuna-demo --config config/demo.local.json ```

Asuna Cognition Core

A framework for AI characters that live with you, on your own machine.

简体中文 · Running Asuna · Install

## What Asuna is Most chatbots wait to be spoken to, answer, and forget. Asuna is built for a character who *stays*: one with a home, a sense of time, people they know, memories they keep, and work they can actually get done. Asuna is the home; the character is a **persona package** you bring. The framework knows nothing about who lives in it. Personality, voice, and skills all come from the persona package, and a different package gives you a different character in the same home. Asuna also knows nothing about where the character meets people: each platform is a **channel package** you plug in. ## What a character can do **Think with two brains.** Every turn is led by the *character brain*: the part that is the character, that listens, feels, remembers, decides what to say, and says it. When something needs doing, such as looking things up, reading files, writing code, or checking a device, the character hands it to the *action brain*. It does the work with real tools in a sandbox and reports back, and the character decides what the result means. You can watch both brains side by side, each with its own colour: purple for the character, blue for the action. **Live at home, on their own rhythm.** The private chat with the owner is the character's home, not just an inbox. A heartbeat gives them time of their own: they can do nothing, follow up on something, or decide to drop by a group and start a topic. Each night they look back over the day and decide what is worth remembering for good. **Meet people where they are.** In group chats the character reads the room before speaking. They join in when called or when they have something to add, stay quiet when they don't, and get to know each person over time. **Keep memories of their own.** Characters write and revise their own notes and documents, keep a mood that carries from one conversation to the next, and recall what matters when it matters. Their inner state reaches them as words, not numbers, and they change it by choosing, not by typing values. **Grow by themselves.** A character keeps a notebook of things they'd like to improve, works on their own package in its own copy, and publishes the change only once it passes its checks and has been reviewed. **Stay trustworthy.** What a character shares with the owner stays private; groups only hear what is meant for them. Code runs in a sandbox, everything said on a platform goes through an audited outbox, and new abilities, a device on the home network for example, are granted one at a time when the character asks for them and says why. **Talk to other agents.** A *peer line* connects a character to an agent living in another DeepSeek Harness, such as an earlier version of the same character. The two can talk directly and hand knowledge over, and the line is the character's to open or close. ## What it looks like

The character brain (purple) hands a small task to the action brain (blue) with clear limits; the action brain reports what it found. The sidebar and names are blurred.

## How a moment flows ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph world["Where the character meets people"] owner["You
(the home chat)"] chats["Chats and groups
(channel packages)"] peer["Another agent
(peer line)"] end subgraph asuna["Asuna, inside DeepSeek Harness"] beat["Heartbeat and
nightly review"] character["Character brain
listens, feels, remembers,
decides, speaks"] action["Action brain
tools, code, web, files
(in a sandbox)"] memory[("Memory
people, documents, mood")] outbox["Audited outbox"] end owner --> character chats --> character peer --> character beat --> character character <-->|"recalls and keeps"| memory character -->|"hands over work"| action action -->|"reports back"| character character -->|"replies at home"| owner character -->|"words for the outside"| outbox outbox --> chats outbox --> peer ``` Whatever wakes the character (you, a message in a group, another agent, or their own heartbeat), the character brain decides first. Work goes to the action brain and comes back as a report. Words for the outside world leave only through the outbox, where each one is recorded. ## Built on DeepSeek Harness Asuna is a set of plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). DSH supplies the agent runtime and the web interface, and Asuna adds the character on top: the two brains, memory in MongoDB, the daily rhythm, and the channels. It reuses DSH's own interface instead of building another, so what you see is the regular DSH web page, with the character's conversations, the two brains' colours, and a memory panel added to it. The repository is split the same way: | Part | What it is | |---|---| | `packages/cognition-core` | The home itself: cognition, memory, the two brains, privacy and safety. It names no character and no platform. | | `packages/channels/napcat-qq` | A channel for QQ, through NapCat. | | `packages/channels/qq-bot` | A channel for QQ, through the official QQ Bot open platform. | | `packages/channels/dsh-peer` | A channel to an agent in another DeepSeek Harness (the peer line). | | `packages/personas/` | Persona packages, each run with a different set of channels: `ichinose-asuna` (local chat only), `kyoyama-kazusa` (QQ), and `xiaoman`, the author's personal one (QQ and a peer line). | | `tests/fixtures/personas/demo` | A small synthetic persona, used by the tests and for trying things out. | | `deploy/docker` | A Docker stack that runs the same install on a Linux host. | ## Getting started You need DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2, Python 3.12+, MongoDB with vector search, a model server for each brain (both brains may share one), and a persona package. Optional: NapCat for QQ. Commands run under DSH's own sandbox, on Windows, Linux or macOS. - **Installing the released plugins into DSH:** follow [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md). It is written so a person or a coding agent can follow it. - **Running from this repository:** see [RUN_ASUNA.md](RUN_ASUNA.md). `start-asuna.cmd` (Windows) or `./start-asuna.sh` (Linux, macOS) opens the home; then visit the address it prints. For Docker, see [deploy/docker](deploy/docker/README.md). - **For developers and coding agents:** start with [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md). [NATIVE_PLUGIN.md](NATIVE_PLUGIN.md) explains how the packages compose inside DSH and [RUNTIME_API.md](RUNTIME_API.md) describes the channel and tool contracts. Design decisions are kept in [docs/development_plans](docs/development_plans/README.md). ## License The core and the channel packages are licensed under the [GNU General Public License v3.0 only](LICENSE). Persona packages are not part of the release.

# DSH Code Review

DSH 的只读代码审查插件。它比较 Git 或 SVN 中的代码变更，使用当前 Agent 的模型分析问题，并返回带文件位置、证据和复核结果的中文报告。

**不会修改代码、自动修复、提交、回滚或发布业务项目。模型报告仍需人工判断。**

## 安装

环境要求：Node.js 22 或更新版本，以及目标仓库使用的 Git 或 SVN 命令行工具。插件依赖 DSH 的工具和模型服务，不能脱离 DSH 单独运行。

在 DSH 中通过插件管理器安装并启用，或使用：

	dsh plugin add https://github.com/f-e-n-g-0531/dsh-code-review.git

升级后确认当前 DSH 进程已经加载新版本。仓库发布新版本不会自动更新正在运行的 DSH；本项目也不会自动修改已有 profile 或重启宿主。

> 许可限制：本项目采用非商业源码公开许可证。公司内部商业项目、收费服务及商业交付需要另行取得书面授权。详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

## 第一次使用

在目标仓库的 DSH Agent 会话中，可以这样提出请求：

> 审查 src/api.ts 和 src/client.ts 的改动。先展示审查范围和模型目的地，确认后再执行。不要修改代码。

插件提供两个工具：

1. **code_review_preview**：读取本地变更，列出审查文件、额外上下文、排除原因和模型目的地。此步骤不调用模型。
2. **code_review_execute**：接收预览返回的 previewId 和 confirmed: true。执行前重新检查文件；只有预览仍有效且宿主允许执行时，才把批准内容发送给当前 Agent 模型。

调用示例：

	{"selectedPaths":["src/api.ts","src/client.ts"],"autoContext":true}

执行参数为：

	{"previewId":"预览返回的ID","confirmed":true}

执行返回中文 Markdown 报告，以及 JSON 格式的结构化报告。代码、会话目录或模型路由变化后，需要重新预览。

## 可以审查什么

| 场景 | 支持情况 |
|---|---|
| Git 工作区 | HEAD 与工作区的净变化，包含暂存和未暂存改动；没有单独的 staged/unstaged 模式 |
| Git 单个提交 | 使用 commit 参数；与唯一父提交比较，根提交与空旧版本比较。合并提交请使用区间模式 |
| Git 两个版本 | 使用 baseRevision 和 targetRevision；比较两个版本的文件树，不自动计算合并基点 |
| SVN 工作副本 | 本地 BASE 与工作副本比较，默认不连接远端 |
| SVN 固定历史版本（初始模式） | svnRevision 对比 r-1/r，或 svnBaseRevision/svnTargetRevision 固定树端点；从工作副本根的仓库 URL 读取，不使用脏工作树。远端必须显式 svnAllowNetwork:true |
| 多个子仓库 | 用 repositoryPath 指定会话工作区中的一个仓库根目录；每个仓库分别预览和执行 |

未跟踪文件必须通过 selectedPaths 显式选入。省略 selectedPaths 时，审查范围是仓库根目录的变更，不只是当前子目录。

## 常用参数

所有文件路径都相对于本次选定的仓库，使用正斜杠；不要使用绝对路径、上级路径或链接目录。

| 参数 | 用途 | 示例 |
|---|---|---|
| selectedPaths | 只审查选中的变更文件 | ["src/api.ts"] |
| repositoryPath | 指定工作区内的子仓库 | "project-a" |
| contextPaths | 手动加入理解代码所需的文件 | ["src/types.ts"] |
| autoContext | 从变更及手动上下文寻找依赖；Git 和 SVN 最多沿三层依赖链读取 | true |
| callerScopePaths | 在指定目录中寻找引用变更文件的代码；已捕获调用方会标出调用行与唯一声明行 | ["src/clients"] |
| oldContextPaths | Git/SVN 固定历史审查中，只加入旧版本的上下文；共享上下文名额 | ["src/removed-helper.ts"] |
| rulePaths | 加入项目审查规则，最多四个 UTF-8 Markdown 或文本文件 | ["review-rules.md"] |
| businessRequirement | 提供业务要求；不是缺陷证据，也不会增加读取权限 | "请求失败时必须释放连接" |
| reviewRounds | 独立审查次数，1～3，默认 1；会增加模型调用量 | 2 |

commit 与 baseRevision/targetRevision 不能同时使用。oldContextPaths 只能用于 Git/SVN 固定历史审查，不适用于工作副本模式。

SVN 历史模式使用独立参数，不可与 Git 参数混用。示例：`{"svnRevision":"7315","svnAllowNetwork":true}`；或 `{"svnBaseRevision":"7314","svnTargetRevision":"7315","svnAllowNetwork":true}`。只接受固定十进制 revision，不接受 HEAD、日期或相对别名。仅选择工作副本根当前仓库 URL，不支持任意远端 URL；预览会读取明确端点的仓库元数据与源码（远端需显式许可），但不发送模型。历史模式支持显式 contextPaths 与 rulePaths：上下文按目标版和已核验的旧版正文分别保存，规则只读取目标版；共享 20 上下文名额与原采集预算。oldContextPaths 可显式选择仅旧版正文，没有目标占位，选中旧变更复用原身份；不能恢复已排除/阻断/无旧侧的变更。autoContext 和历史 callerScopePaths 仍未支持，不能回退到当前工作副本。目录新增/删除按后代逐项覆盖，凭据、链接/特殊节点与超限继续拒绝。

自动上下文和引用方发现是保守的文本导航，不是编译器分析。动态导入、宏、重载、继承和实例方法可能无法解析；找到引用不等于证明函数实际被调用。历史调用方的命名导入线索逐侧对应相同版本声明，标明 side/revision；缺少该版本的批准正文不回退另一侧。Git 历史可沿修改前后两侧分别捕获最多三层依赖；SVN 工作副本模式可沿安全的当前节点取得最多三层依赖；初始固定 revision 历史模式尚不支持历史依赖导航。已批准正文中的唯一命名声明和唯一 default 导出会标出位置；同名、重导出或跨侧内容不猜测。命名空间导入后的独立成员调用可导航至唯一命名声明；写入、逃逸或间接调用不推定绑定，不是实例类型分析。

## 如何读报告

先看**覆盖情况和限制**，再看问题列表：

- completed：相应阶段完成，不表示代码绝对正确。
- partial：只完成部分工作；检查未完成文件、证据不足或预算限制。
- failed：审查执行失败，不是“审核通过”。
- cancelled：审查被取消。

每个候选问题会保留位置、触发条件、影响和复核结果。复核可能支持、反驳、无法确定或未完成；被反驳的候选不会悄悄删除。程序会核对引用的位置和原文，但这不能代替人工判断缺陷是否成立。

额外上下文被读取，不等于它已作为主文件完成审查。没有发现问题，也不证明代码没有缺陷。

## 数据与安全

- 预览会在本地读取选定变更和上下文；确认执行后，这些内容可能发送给当前模型提供方。发送前请检查范围。
- 插件沿用 DSH 正常工具权限，不额外发起一套审批；confirmed 只确认预览，不能绕过宿主权限。
- 不执行项目代码、构建脚本或模型生成的 shell 命令。模型只能在批准的快照中查找、搜索和读取。
- 常见凭据路径会被排除，但普通源码也可能含秘密。路径过滤不能代替人工检查。
- 二进制、不能解码的文件、链接和超限内容会被阻断，不会自动截断后假装完成。
- SVN 同仓库复制新增文件以空目标旧侧审查，copyfrom URL/revision/UUID 在预览中披露，仅作来源信息，不自动读取来源正文，也不认定为已验证重命名。文件移动的新增/删除两侧分别覆盖。普通目录新增/删除会逐项列出后代；选择目录不会自动批准后代，未全选或子项阻断会标明覆盖不足。同仓库目录复制会显式展开后代，将继承 copied 的正常/修改节点作为空目标旧侧的新增审查，来源身份逐项披露。替换、切换目录、外部工作副本、冲突及部分属性状态仍未支持；含 svn:keywords 的文件仍阻断。全面扩展进度见 [SVN 支持矩阵](SVN-SUPPORT-MATRIX.md)。

## 默认规模限制

| 项目 | 默认上限 |
|---|---|
| 变更文件 | 200 个 |
| 单文件 | 256 KiB |
| 全部快照 | 4 MiB |
| 额外上下文 | 共 20 个文件，手动与自动来源共享 |
| 单次模型输入 | 约 96 KiB |
| 一次审查的模型调用 | 100 次，多个审查阶段共享 |

大变更可以按保留原始行号的差异窗口分批分析；不能容纳的部分会明确标为未完成。详细读取、时间和发现预算见 [开发与发布指南](DEVELOPMENT.md)。

## 文档导航

- [版本变化](CHANGELOG.md)：各版对使用者有何影响。
- [本次发布说明](RELEASE-NOTES.md)：新版本内容、升级注意事项及限制。
- [开发与发布指南](DEVELOPMENT.md)：测试、打包、发布和失败恢复。
- [核心能力对照](CORE-ALIGNMENT-TASKS.md)：已具备能力与尚未完成的差距。
- [参考源码对照](CORE-SOURCE-INVENTORY.md)：维护者使用的固定参考来源。
- [评测说明](https://github.com/f-e-n-g-0531/dsh-code-review/blob/main/evaluation/README.md)：样本、试跑观察及其证据限制。

最新安装包与正式版本以 [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@feng0531/dsh-code-review) 和 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/f-e-n-g-0531/dsh-code-review/releases) 为准。发布与安装成功不代表真实模型的误报率或漏报率已经得到证明。

dsh-im-companion

**中文** · [English](docs/README.en.md) **dsh-im-companion 以助理和家的概念增强dsh-im的使用体验。** 你的 ⭐是我夜空中最亮的星。 *Give every agent a home — IM Companion handles the rest.* [![版本](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-im-companion?label=版本)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-im-companion) [![下载量](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.npmjs.org%2Fdownloads%2Fpoint%2Flast-month%2Fdsh-im-companion&query=%24.downloads&label=下载量&suffix=/月&color=brightgreen)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-im-companion) [![最近更新](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/FeatherHunter/dsh-im-companion?label=最近更新&color=FE7D37)](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-im-companion/commits/master) [![许可证](https://img.shields.io/badge/许可证-MIT-lightgrey.svg)](LICENSE) [![上游本体](https://img.shields.io/badge/上游-dsh--im-3370ff)](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im) [![期待你参与](https://img.shields.io/badge/期待你参与-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-im-companion/issues)
👇 有助理的工作区，一目了然。
👇 额外增强DSH原生会话状态。
**装它，1 分钟（先装 dsh-im，再装辅助）。**

INSTALL
安装

前置要求：[DSH](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh)（DeepSeek Harness）+ [dsh-im](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im)（IM 机器人本体）。
```bash # 1 安装 DSH CLI（已装跳过） npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh # 2 先装本体 dsh-im（已装跳过，同样 --profile 必填） dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-im # 或者 dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-im # 3 再装辅助（--profile 必填，装进实际使用的入口） dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-im-companion # 或者 dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-im-companion # 锁定版本更稳（当前 0.2.8） dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-im-companion@0.2.8 --registry https://registry.npmjs.org ```
装完刷新页面即生效。若面板没有出现，请完全退出 DSH 后重新打开。
把安装交给你的 AI 复制下面这段发给你的 AI： ```text 请帮我安装 DeepSeek Harness 插件 dsh-im-companion（IM 辅助）。 先读仓库 README：https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-im-companion 先确认我实际使用的 DSH 入口对应哪个 profile（桌面应用走 desktop，自启 web 服务走 web）， 先确认 dsh-im 本体已装进同一个 profile（没装先装），再把辅助装进正确的 profile。 ```
更新不生效时怎么装 下面以 desktop 为例，web 用户请把 --profile desktop 换成 --profile web： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-im-companion@0.2.8 --registry https://registry.npmjs.org npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-im-companion dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-im-companion@latest --registry https://registry.npmjs.org ```
升级 · 卸载： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop update dsh-im-companion dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-im-companion ```

COMPAT
兼容性

| dsh-im-companion | dsh-im | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | **0.2.x** | **4.21.1**（已验证） | 与 0.1.16+ 同传输口径；新增更新中心（面板自写 status 轮询，受契约 §4 三条约束）与 `meta.motion.set` / `meta.update.set` 两个偏好端点 | | **0.1.16+** | **4.21.1**（已验证） | 双传输口径不变：4.17.1+ 走 `/api` 新载体，≤4.17.0 自动回退旧路由；4.21.1 的载体规则已复核与 4.17.1 一致（`dsh-im` + `{ method, payload }`） | | 0.1.7 – 0.1.15 | 4.17.1（已验证） | 双传输：4.17.1+ 走 `/api` 新载体，≤4.17.0 自动回退旧路由——两边都能用 | | 0.1.6 | 4.17.1 | **web profile 装配失败**（host 半走已退役的前缀路由，报 `cannot get property "webServer" without inject`）→ 请升级 0.1.7 | | 0.1.4 | ≤4.17.0 | dsh-im 4.17.1 改道后不可用（接入向导报 HTTP 405），请升级到 0.1.7 | 宿主 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.2.0-rc.2** 已验证（**0.2.2 配的就是这个宿主版本**；要求宿主提供 `connection.fetch`；更老宿主会在装配期显式报错，不静默降级）。面板右上角并列两枚版本胶囊，颜色即身份：紫=本插件版本号、蓝白=兼容的 `dsh-im` 版本（`dsh-im 4.21.1`）；宿主 dsh 胶囊已删（用户裁定 2026-10-01），宿主兼容口径只留本小节与市场徽章（`engines.dsh`）。胶囊只留轴名 + 版本号，完整口径在悬停（值来自 `package.json`，构建时注入），升级前看一眼即可。

WHY
为什么要做 IM 辅助

dsh-im 掌管接入，dsh-im-companion 以助理和家的概念增强能力。 **家**：哪个工作区有助理在管、在不在线，尽收眼底；搬家拖一下就行。 👇 点“有助理”，只看已安家的。

IN ACTION
真机演示

👇 进设置 → IM机器人增强：助理、渠道、在线状态一屏看尽。 👇 切按渠道：同渠道助理排一排。 👇 点“添加接入”：选家后扫码即绑定。 👇 点开助理卡：模式、状态、各渠道增强开关一目了然。 👇 舰队雷达：Agent × 渠道矩阵，全舰队谁在线一眼看清。 👇 会话状态一目了然（DSH增强）。

L3 · 二次开发（加功能 / 加端点）

1. 新功能 = 建 `src/features//manifest.ts`，再在 `src/features/index.ts` 加一行。 2. `FeatureManifest = { id, name, order, slots[], installStyles? }`；特性上下文 `FeatureCtx = { rpc, subscribe, refresh, meta, slots, get, pickDirectory? }`——特性只经它拿能力，不直连宿主、不引别的特性。 3. 新端点 = 在 `src/host/rpc.ts` 追加一个 `case`（命名 `im-companion..`），既有 case 不改。 4. 红线与自检：单文件 ≤300 行；共享层只加不改；`npm run check`（构建 ＋ 类型 ＋ 功能断言 ＋ 红线）全绿才算数。 5. 契约权威：`docs/features-contract.md`；领域词汇：`CONTEXT.md`。 给 AI 的用法提示：改状态走 `meta.*`；读状态走 `meta.get` ＋ `activity.snapshot`；装更新走 `imc.updateCheck` → `imc.updateInstall`；加功能走 L3。

FAQ

更新之后还是旧版本？ 这是桌面端的应用市场缓存策略导致的：刚发布的版本几小时内更新会静默跳过。等几小时再更新；等不及就显式指定官方源装一次： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-im-companion@latest --registry https://registry.npmjs.org ```

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck

**中文** · [English](docs/README.en.md) **拨开战争迷雾看见终点，剩下的交给 MattSkillsDeck。** 让 [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) 在 DSH 里化作一块看得见、派得动的任务板。 你的 ⭐是我夜空中最亮的星。 *Part the fog of war, see the end — MattSkillsDeck handles the rest.* [![版本](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck?label=%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck) [![下载量](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.npmjs.org%2Fdownloads%2Fpoint%2Flast-month%2Fdsh-mattpocock-skills-deck&query=%24.downloads&label=%E4%B8%8B%E8%BD%BD%E9%87%8F&suffix=%2F%E6%9C%88&color=brightgreen)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck) [![下载总量](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck?label=%E4%B8%8B%E8%BD%BD%E6%80%BB%E9%87%8F&color=red)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck) [![最近更新](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck?label=%E6%9C%80%E8%BF%91%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0&color=FE7D37)](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck/commits/main) [![月提交](https://img.shields.io/github/commit-activity/m/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck?label=%E6%8F%90%E4%BA%A4%E6%95%B0&color=DFAB01)](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck/graphs/commit-activity) [![许可证](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E8%AE%B8%E5%8F%AF%E8%AF%81-MIT-lightgrey.svg)](LICENSE) [![技能包](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E6%8A%80%E8%83%BD%E5%8C%85-mattpocock%2Fskills-9D7CD8)](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) [![期待你参与](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E6%9C%9F%E5%BE%85%E4%BD%A0%E5%8F%82%E4%B8%8E-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck/issues)

INSTALL
安装

前置要求：[DSH](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh)（DeepSeek Harness）。在 DSH 里，你下指令、AI 干活；MattSkillsDeck 把这些活变成面板上的任务。 任务板绑定的仓库需要写权限：新建标签要 push 权限，给票打标签要 triage 及以上权限；只有读权限时能建票、能读票，但补标签、标签流转与 wayfinder 标签都不可用。
```bash # ① 安装 DSH CLI（已装跳过） npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh # ② 安装 MattSkillsDeck —— --profile 必填：装进你实际使用的 DSH 入口对应的 profile # （装错 profile 等于没装，重启多少次都不会加载） dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck # 用自启 web 服务（dsh web） # 或者 dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck # 用 DSH Desktop 桌面应用 # 锁定最新版更稳（当前 1.7.51）： dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck@1.7.51 --registry https://registry.npmjs.org # 或者 dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck@1.7.51 --registry https://registry.npmjs.org ```
装完**重启一次对应的 DSH 入口**即生效：桌面应用完全退出并重开 DSH Desktop；web 服务重启 `dsh web` 后刷新页面。零配置。 **右侧面板性能极致优化：点击到内容可见，真机实测从 5075 毫秒降到 193 毫秒，性能提升约 96.2%（约 26 倍）。** 面板就开在 DSH 自己的右侧边栏里：左边列表、右边详情，并排看。不需要再装别的插件。 **👇 装完重启，面板就绪就是这个样子。**
进阶安装：免全局、更新不生效、交给 AI 下面命令以 web profile 为例——**DSH Desktop 桌面应用用户请把所有 `--profile web` 换成 `--profile desktop`**。 ```bash # 免全局安装（想更稳，像上面一样锁版本） npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck # 更新被静默忽略时，显式指定官方源 dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck@latest --registry https://registry.npmjs.org ``` 复制下面这段发给你的 AI，它会确认 profile、检查环境并按需安装： ```text 请帮我安装 DeepSeek Harness 插件 dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck（MattSkillsDeck）。 先读仓库 README：https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck 先确认我实际使用的 DSH 入口对应哪个 profile（DSH Desktop 桌面应用 → desktop；自启 web 服务 → web），把插件装进正确的 profile； 然后自行检查环境并按需安装（已装的跳过），完成后简要汇报结果。 ```
升级 · 卸载（desktop profile 用户把 `--profile web` 换成 `--profile desktop`）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck # 升级 dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck # 卸载 ```

BOARD
任务板列表

仓库里的任务不再是流水账：面板把它们按可接、阻塞、已关闭归位，进度走到哪一格一眼看清。每行任务的按钮就是动作入口：点一下，写好的指令填进输入框，确认后再发送。地图类型的行永远置顶，已关闭的收成一行。 **👇 任务在哪看、状态怎么筛，全在这张图。**

STATUSBAR
底部任务栏

每条会话输入框下面都有一条胶囊状态栏：可接数量、待修（BUG）数量、诊断、沉淀、交接、环境进度都在上面。点可接、环境等主要分段，即跳到对应面板页，看完即回，不打断手头会话。 **👇 离手最近的操作条，完整一条长这样。**

DETAIL
ISSUE 详情与评论

点开任意一条任务，描述、标签、认领人与评论都在面板里排好版，不用跳终端。在底部输入框直接回话，一般只按标签显示其中一个（诊断、修复、讨论、执行），需要另起再点新会话。 **👇 点开一条任务，看透并回上话。**

NEW SESSION
新会话

任何活都能另起干净会话干：详情页顶部点新会话，新会话标题自动起好，承接指令已预填，人只管检查后发送。当前会话不受扰，脏活累活都在新会话里。 **👇 点一下新会话，指令已预填等人发。**

SKILLS
技能快捷入口

随包 27 个技能（快照 v1.3.1）装好即用：面板技能页顶部给通用推荐（默认 /ask-matt），列表一行讲清一个技能的中文用途，点加载就把斜杠指令填进输入框。完整名单与教程见 Matt 官方 [aihero.dev/skills](https://www.aihero.dev/skills)，本插件只讲入口与推荐。

BACKENDS
多后端切换

同一个面板可换跑道：设置页后端选择器列出 GitHub、本地 Markdown、GitLab 与 Other（无后端）逃生舱。切换只换数据源：切换后原数据不可见，原后端数据保留，切回来又可见。新人第一次大多只用一条跑道，知道能换即可。 **👇 换跑道不断数据，选择器长这样。**

FAQ
常见问题

更新之后还是旧版本？ 这是 DSH 桌面端的 pnpm 供应链策略（`minimumReleaseAge`）导致的：刚发布的版本，几个小时内 `dsh plugin update` 和插件市场的「更新」按钮都会静默跳过。更新后请完全退出 DSH 再重开，按 Ctrl+F5 刷新页面；还没更新的话，显式指定官方源装一次： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck@latest --registry https://registry.npmjs.org ``` **👇 官方源装最新版，成功回显长这样。**
更新报错找不到新版本（No matching version），地址是镜像源？ 这是镜像源还没有同步到新版本：报错地址写着镜像源（例如 `registry.npmmirror.com`），而新版本已经在官方源上发布，包本身没有漏发。等镜像源同步完成就能正常更新；着急用的话，显式指定官方源装一次（下面这条命令不要去掉末尾的源参数，去掉就会走回镜像源）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck@latest --registry https://registry.npmjs.org ``` 桌面应用用户把 `--profile web` 换成 `--profile desktop`。

JOIN
欢迎您加入我们

非常欢迎提交PR、共同维护项目，现在迭代中很缺对markdown后端的开发和完善，Gitlab目前无人力开发。

# @dsh-agentic-roleplay/core

The UI, orchestration, world authoring, media, and filesystem integration plugin behind DSH Agentic Roleplay.

It provides the bounded game-master loop, point-of-view character agents, world and session interfaces, approval-gated authoring agents and tools, story compaction, speech integration, and image-generation workflows. It turns the structured state supplied by [`@dsh-agentic-roleplay/state`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dsh-agentic-roleplay/state) into a playable and editable experience.

## Install

Most users should install [`@dsh-agentic-roleplay/all`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dsh-agentic-roleplay/all). Install this package separately only when assembling a custom DSH profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @dsh-agentic-roleplay/state
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @dsh-agentic-roleplay/core
```

The state package must be installed and enabled first. Installing the core package brings the state package code into the profile, but DSH activates only bundles selected explicitly.

This is an independent community project maintained by Firefox2100, not an official DSH package.

[Documentation](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/intro) · [Architecture](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/developers/architecture) · [Source](https://github.com/Firefox2100/dsh-agentic-roleplay) · [Issues](https://github.com/Firefox2100/dsh-agentic-roleplay/issues)

# DSH Agentic Roleplay

Persistent, agent-driven roleplay for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness). Create a world, choose who to play, and enter an evolving story whose characters can make decisions of their own.

Instead of treating roleplay as one long prompt, the bundle separates the game master, character decisions, record keeping, world authoring, and media work. The story keeps structured state for what happened, what each character perceived and remembers, where people and things are, how relationships change, and which possibilities remain open.

## What makes it different

- **Characters have their own point of view.** They act from their goals, relationships, knowledge, memories, and current situation—not from everything stored in the world.
- **The world changes without becoming a script.** Plots can provide direction and pressure, while player choices and autonomous character actions determine what actually happens.
- **Stories remain editable and durable.** Worlds are filesystem-first, sessions use SQLite, and branching or taking back does not require rebuilding the setting.
- **Creation happens inside DSH.** Build worlds in the editor, ask an approval-gated authoring agent for help, import character cards, and generate portraits or scene illustrations when providers are available.
- **Media is optional.** Text play works without image, speech, embedding, or reranking services; add them when you want portraits, voiced scenes, voice input, or richer recall.

The bundle includes a complete roleplay interface, a bounded game-master loop, autonomous character and faction activity, story-time memory, relationships and knowledge, locations and items, plots and triggers, reusable avatars, world authoring, speech, and image workflows.

This project is independently maintained by [Firefox2100](https://github.com/Firefox2100). It is not an official DeepSeek Harness project.

## Documentation

- [English documentation](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/intro)
- [简体中文文档](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/zh-Hans/docs/intro)
- [Installation](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/getting-started/installation)
- [World authoring](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/authoring/overview)
- [World format](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/world-format/overview)
- [Plugin development](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/developers/architecture)
- [Maintainer guide](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/maintainers/overview)

## Packages

| Package | Role |
|---|---|
| `@dsh-agentic-roleplay/all` | Installable bundle containing the complete experience. |
| `@dsh-agentic-roleplay/core` | UI, orchestration, authoring, media, and filesystem integration. |
| `@dsh-agentic-roleplay/state` | Standalone DSH service for session databases, repositories, recall, and model-facing record tools. |
| `dsh-roleplay-model` | Private canonical model package, bundled into the published plugins. |

## Installation

Install the complete bundle into a DSH profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @dsh-agentic-roleplay/all
```

Restart the profile, then configure the storage root under **Settings → Role Play**. AI features are supplied by compatible provider plugins; see [AI services](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/getting-started/ai-services).

New users can add the included *Blackwater Observatory* sample world from the Worlds page, inspect how it is built, and begin a session immediately after configuring a language model.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run test
pnpm run build
```

Requires Node.js 22 or later and pnpm. See the [maintainer guide](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/maintainers/overview) before changing persisted data, the agent loop, prompts, or DSH integration.

# @dsh-agentic-roleplay/all

The complete persistent, agent-driven roleplay experience for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), maintained by Firefox2100.

Create editable worlds and play stories coordinated by a game master while autonomous character agents act from their own goals, relationships, knowledge, and memories. The bundle preserves locations, items, time, factions, plots, perceptions, and consequences as structured session state rather than relying on one ever-growing chat prompt.

It installs the roleplay UI and orchestration plugin, the persistent state service, and the DSH voice-input components used by the interface. It also provides an approval-gated world-authoring assistant, reusable avatars, branching and take-back, optional speech, portraits, and scene illustrations. AI models and media services are configured separately through [DSH AI Providers](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-ai-providers/docs/intro).

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @dsh-agentic-roleplay/all
```

After installation, restart the profile and configure the roleplay storage root under **Settings → Role Play**.

Start with the included *Blackwater Observatory* sample world, or create a world in the editor without leaving DSH. Only a language-model route is required for play; embeddings, reranking, images, TTS, and STT are optional enhancements.

This is an independent community project. It is not an official DSH package and is not maintained or endorsed by the DSH maintainers.

[Documentation](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/intro) · [Installation guide](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/getting-started/installation) · [Source](https://github.com/Firefox2100/dsh-agentic-roleplay) · [Issues](https://github.com/Firefox2100/dsh-agentic-roleplay/issues)

Licensed under GPL-3.0-only.

# DSH Agentic Roleplay

Persistent, agent-driven roleplay for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness). Create a world, choose who to play, and enter an evolving story whose characters can make decisions of their own.

Instead of treating roleplay as one long prompt, the bundle separates the game master, character decisions, record keeping, world authoring, and media work. The story keeps structured state for what happened, what each character perceived and remembers, where people and things are, how relationships change, and which possibilities remain open.

## What makes it different

- **Characters have their own point of view.** They act from their goals, relationships, knowledge, memories, and current situation—not from everything stored in the world.
- **The world changes without becoming a script.** Plots can provide direction and pressure, while player choices and autonomous character actions determine what actually happens.
- **Stories remain editable and durable.** Worlds are filesystem-first, sessions use SQLite, and branching or taking back does not require rebuilding the setting.
- **Creation happens inside DSH.** Build worlds in the editor, ask an approval-gated authoring agent for help, import character cards, and generate portraits or scene illustrations when providers are available.
- **Media is optional.** Text play works without image, speech, embedding, or reranking services; add them when you want portraits, voiced scenes, voice input, or richer recall.

The bundle includes a complete roleplay interface, a bounded game-master loop, autonomous character and faction activity, story-time memory, relationships and knowledge, locations and items, plots and triggers, reusable avatars, world authoring, speech, and image workflows.

This project is independently maintained by [Firefox2100](https://github.com/Firefox2100). It is not an official DeepSeek Harness project.

## Documentation

- [English documentation](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/intro)
- [简体中文文档](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/zh-Hans/docs/intro)
- [Installation](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/getting-started/installation)
- [World authoring](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/authoring/overview)
- [World format](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/world-format/overview)
- [Plugin development](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/developers/architecture)
- [Maintainer guide](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/maintainers/overview)

## Packages

| Package | Role |
|---|---|
| `@dsh-agentic-roleplay/all` | Installable bundle containing the complete experience. |
| `@dsh-agentic-roleplay/core` | UI, orchestration, authoring, media, and filesystem integration. |
| `@dsh-agentic-roleplay/state` | Standalone DSH service for session databases, repositories, recall, and model-facing record tools. |
| `dsh-roleplay-model` | Private canonical model package, bundled into the published plugins. |

## Installation

Install the complete bundle into a DSH profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @dsh-agentic-roleplay/all
```

Restart the profile, then configure the storage root under **Settings → Role Play**. AI features are supplied by compatible provider plugins; see [AI services](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/getting-started/ai-services).

New users can add the included *Blackwater Observatory* sample world from the Worlds page, inspect how it is built, and begin a session immediately after configuring a language model.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run test
pnpm run build
```

Requires Node.js 22 or later and pnpm. See the [maintainer guide](https://firefox2100.github.io/dsh-agentic-roleplay/docs/maintainers/overview) before changing persisted data, the agent loop, prompts, or DSH integration.

## License
