One thing worth stating plainly, because the paragraph above used to overstate it: this package is a fork of [`dsh-codex-ui`](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui) and **also carries upstream's non-visual features** — a dependency panel that can run `pnpm` and rewrite `node_modules`, session moves between workspaces, and "open in file manager". They are inherited rather than written here, and they are what the About page exposes. You can simply not use them, but they do ship in this package. See [Scope and permissions](#scope-and-permissions). ## What you get | Area | What the skin does | | --- | --- | | **Layout** | ZCode sidebar geometry — 8px radii, 32px rows, `px-2 / py-3 / gap-1` spacing, 150–200ms `ease-out` motion, seven-step type scale | | **Colour** | Full Zai Light / Zai Dark palettes written into DSH's `--dsw-*` token layer; official regions (title bar, session list, buttons, menus, composer shell) recolour as one piece | | **Icons** | Lucide (the same icon library ZCode uses) for sidebar navigation and row actions | | **Theme** | Follows the host's own light/dark preference via `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`; light canvas `#f8f8f8`, dark canvas `#161616` | | **Sidebar behaviour** | Pin / group / drag-reorder projects and conversations, unread and running indicators, header search over sessions + settings + quick actions, rename / archive / fork / copy / delete, turn navigation in long conversations, Up/Down recall of previous input | ## Screenshots The two images at the top of this page are the light and dark sidebar + workspace tree. A few more views. > Project names, conversation titles and the balance figures in every screenshot are **demo data** — the > captures are sanitised before committing so no real workspace ever appears in this repository. Settings page — selected states are neutral, matching the sidebar (no blue leftovers from the host defaults): ![Settings page, light theme](assets/screenshots/settings-light.png) Header search across conversations and settings: ![Header search, light theme](assets/screenshots/search-light.png) Collapsed rail — icon-only, with tooltips on hover: ![Collapsed rail, light theme](assets/screenshots/collapsed-light.png) ## How it differs from upstream This fork keeps upstream's interaction scaffolding and data layer, and adds: - **The ZCode skin itself** — 174 `--dsw-*` tokens per theme (light and dark) plus 21 structural tokens, 195 unique token names in total. Every token consumed anywhere in `src/` is covered by the maps; the `token-coverage` assertion fails the build if that ever stops being true. - **Theme single-source-of-truth** — the host attribute is the only signal. No `prefers-color-scheme` fallback, which used to split the sidebar and the content area when the host was light but the OS was dark. - **Fixes found by looking at the real interface**, not by reading code: session hover card trimmed to the title only, send button rendered in the real primary colour (`--dcu-primary` is now defined at `:root` so the composer — which lives outside `.dcu-root` — can resolve it), a "back to conversation" entry when a global panel is open, self-drawn sidebar separator lines removed, marquee title clipping, footer separation, and shorter empty-state cards. - **A verification stack that actually runs on this machine** — see [Verification](#verification). Upstream's browser-based layout scripts had never been executed here before (the Chromium binary was missing), which is how five stale assertions stayed hidden. ## Scope and permissions A skin should not need a permissions conversation. This one does, because it is a fork and inherited more than visuals. Being explicit is cheaper than being trusted by accident. | Capability | Reachable from | Touches | | --- | --- | --- | | Recolour the UI | always, on install | DSH's `--dsw-*` token layer and this plugin's own stylesheets. No data. | | Sidebar / session tree / search | always, on install | Renders through official slots. Reads session and workspace lists; never writes conversation records. | | Dependency panel | the About page, on click | Runs `pnpm`, rewrites `node_modules` and `pnpm-workspace.yaml` in the active workspace. | | Move session to workspace | the session context menu | Rewrites that session's artifact files. | | Open in file manager | file path menus | Opens the OS file manager. Read-only. | | Five REST endpoints | the plugin's own UI only | Serves the four features above; authenticated per session. | Everything in the lower four rows is **inherited from [`dsh-codex-ui`](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui)** and is also exposed on the About page inside DSH. If you only want the skin, nothing here runs unless you click it. ## Requirements - A working **DeepSeek Harness Web** installation with `dsh` on your `PATH`. Examples below use the `web` profile; substitute your own profile name. - **Host compatibility.** Peer dependencies declare the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` range `>=0.1.6-alpha.2 <0.3.0-0`; development is pinned to `0.2.0-rc.2`. The heavy gate (`pnpm gate:host`) packs the plugin, installs it into an isolated `DSH_HOME`, and exercises the real `dsh` binary found on the machine — override it with `DCU_DSH_BIN`. - **Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`** if you build from source. - ⚠️ On macOS, do **not** put DSH's bundled Node 24 first on `PATH` when building or testing: it cannot load the `rolldown` native binding (`code signature ... different Team IDs`) and `vitest` / `tsdown` will fail. Any other Node 22.22.x works. ## Install The package is **not published to the npm registry**. Install it straight from GitHub instead — `dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to `pnpm`, which resolves `github:/` natively: ```text dsh plugin --profile web add github:jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui ``` `lib/` is committed and the package defines no `prepare` script, so nothing is compiled during install. ### Ask an agent to install it (recommended) Paste this into any agent that can run terminal commands on your computer: ```text Install the DSH plugin dsh-zcode-ui into my local web profile by running: dsh plugin --profile web add github:jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui Then run dsh --profile web --dump-config, confirm the configuration includes zcode-ui, and explain how to reload DSH and start using the skin. ``` ### Install manually ```powershell [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 $OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 dsh plugin --profile web add github:jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui dsh --profile web --dump-config ``` Restart DSH Web and hard-refresh the browser (usually `Ctrl+Shift+R`). The new sidebar is the sign that the skin is live. Disabling or uninstalling the plugin restores the official interface. ### Install from a local clone (unreleased changes) ```powershell [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 $OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 git clone https://github.com/jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui.git Set-Location .\dsh-zcode-ui pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm build dsh plugin --profile web add . dsh --profile web --dump-config ``` `lib/` is committed, so a clone is usable without building — but rebuild after any change to `src/`. If your pnpm and Node versions disagree, `npm install` followed by `npm run build` is an equivalent fallback. ## Usage Once DSH Web is reloaded, the left navigation is rendered by this plugin. | Goal | Action | | --- | --- | | Start a conversation | **New task**, or the **+** / **New conversation** action on a workspace | | Find something | Type in the header search field; pick a session, a settings page, or a quick action | | Collapse the sidebar | The header panel button; the expand control stays on the collapsed rail | | Return from a global panel | With a panel open, **Back to conversation** appears directly under the panel entry | | Pin a project | Drag it into **Pinned**, or use **Pin project** in its menu | | Manage a conversation | Its menu: rename, pin, mark unread, archive, fork, copy, delete | | Reuse earlier input | Press Up/Down in an empty composer to recall input from this workspace | | Jump between turns | The turn marks to the left of the current conversation | ## FAQ **Nothing changed after installing.** Check that the profile you installed into is the one actually running DSH Web, then restart DSH Web and hard-refresh the browser (`Ctrl+Shift+R`). `dsh --profile web --dump-config` should list `zcode-ui`. If that profile's `cordis.patch.yml` still carries `disabled: true` for `ui-sidebar` or `ui-settings-general`, delete those rows and reload. **Does it touch my conversations, workspaces, or files?** Not by itself. The skin only recolours the interface through DSH's `--dsw-*` token layer and renders the sidebar through official slots and public services. It never writes conversation records, and removing a project from the sidebar does not delete its folder. Two inherited features *do* touch files, but only when you explicitly use them: the dependency panel runs `pnpm` and can rewrite `node_modules`, and "move session to workspace" rewrites that session's artifacts. See [Scope and permissions](#scope-and-permissions). **Can I use it next to other DSH plugins?** Yes. It coexists with the other plugins in your profile. Note that four interface issues reported from real use turned out to belong to the cost-meter and context-pilot plugins rather than this one — they are documented in [`docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md). **Why are three assertions skipped?** They validate the upstream monorepo's release contracts (`packages/`, `.github/workflows/`), which do not exist in this single-package fork. The files are kept with an explicit `SKIP` block instead of being deleted — see [Known limitations](#known-limitations). **Is this an official plugin?** No. It is a personal project with no endorsement from anyone (see the notice at the top). ## Verification Four layers, all runnable locally. `npm run gate` chains them (~55s) and the `pre-push` hook runs it automatically: | Layer | Command | What it covers | | --- | --- | --- | | Types | `npm run typecheck` | `tsc --noEmit` over `src` and `tests` | | Unit / integration | `npm run test:unit` | 47 files, 311 tests | | Contract assertions | `node tests/run-assertions.mjs` | 38 scripts — 35 pass, 3 intentionally skipped | | Real-browser layout | `npm run test:layout` | 12 Chromium scripts measuring real geometry, interaction, contrast and overflow | `npm run gate:host` is the heavy tier: it packs the plugin, installs it into an isolated `DSH_HOME`, starts a real `dsh web`, and runs three live-host scripts (about 1–2 minutes). Use it when you touch slots, injection, or the install flow. The layout scripts need Playwright's Chromium once: `./node_modules/.bin/playwright install chromium`. ## Known limitations Recorded honestly in [`docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md) — the file is the source of truth, and everything below is expanded there: - **Three assertions are skipped on purpose.** They validate the upstream monorepo's release contracts (`packages/`, `.github/workflows/`), which do not exist in this single-package fork. The files are kept with an explicit `SKIP` block rather than deleted, so "test missing" and "problem solved" stay distinguishable. - **Four of the seven interface issues reported from real use are not this plugin's.** They were traced to the cost-meter and context-pilot plugins (duplicate cost display, cramped status bar) and to a host-built-in control; they are documented, not silently ignored. - **Two upstream open issues ([#40](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui/issues/40), [#41](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui/issues/41)) were probed and did not reproduce** at four window sizes on macOS. Non-macOS platforms, real display scaling, and full-screen/split-screen remain untested. - **No CI.** The gate runs locally and on push via the `pre-push` hook. The local `node_modules` is hand-patched to work around a `tsdown` dependency gap; a clean `npm install` may need that reapplied. ## References and acknowledgements This plugin would not exist without these projects: | Project | Role here | | --- | --- | | [MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui) (Apache-2.0) | Fork parent — the sidebar, workspace session tree, search, turn navigation, settings skeleton, test tooling, and data-layer approach all come from here. This fork is `1.1.34` of it, plus the ZCode skin and the fixes listed above. | | [zai-org/ZCode](https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode) (Apache-2.0) | Design source — palette, geometry, icon choices, and motion values were extracted from it (cross-checked against v3.15.1). | | [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) | The host application this plugin plugs into. | | [Lucide](https://lucide.dev/) | Icon set used for the sidebar. | In-repo archives worth reading: - [`docs/ZCODE-DESIGN.md`](docs/ZCODE-DESIGN.md) — the design specification extracted from ZCode. - [`docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md) — known issues, skipped assertions, environment leftovers, release checklist. - [`docs/UPSTREAM-CHANGELOG.md`](docs/UPSTREAM-CHANGELOG.md) — the upstream changelog up to the fork point. - [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) — how to build, verify, and submit changes. ## Feedback and contributing This is a **beta** maintained by one person, so feedback is the main way it improves. - **Something wrong or ugly?** Open an [issue](https://github.com/jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui/issues) — say what you expected, what happened instead, and attach a screenshot if it is visual. Screenshots of the sidebar and the composer are the most useful. - **Idea or improvement?** Same place. Issues are fine for suggestions; there is no separate process. - **Want to send a change?** See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) — `pnpm gate` must pass before a pull request is worth opening. - **Before reporting**, please skim [`docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md): the known limitations are already written down there, including which issues are *not* this plugin's. ## Development ```bash pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm build # tsc --noEmit && tsdown → lib/ pnpm gate # typecheck + assertions + vitest + 11 browser scripts pnpm gate:host # isolated real-host compatibility tier ``` Every script is a plain `package.json` entry, so `npm run build` / `npm run gate` behave identically. After changing `src`, rebuild before installing or committing. New features should reuse existing DSH slots and public services; do not depend on private host DOM or write conversation records. ## License [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE), the same licence as the upstream scaffolding and the ZCode design source. Upstream copyright and attribution notices are retained.

# DSH ChatGPT

<!-- release-state-note -->

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Give any DeepSeek Harness agent ChatGPT web search, image generation, image editing, image understanding, and text analysis, using the Codex app already signed in on your computer. No API key is needed.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @klarkxy/dsh-chatgpt
```

You also need the official Codex, version `0.162.0-alpha.17.2` or later, on the same computer as DSH. Open the plugin page and click **Refresh status**. An existing Codex ChatGPT sign-in is reused; otherwise sign in with the browser or a device code (use the device code for a remote DSH). If Codex is not found, enter its path. You can also pick the model and reasoning effort there.

## Tools

| Tool | Use it to |
| --- | --- |
| `chatgpt_search` | Look up current information with source links |
| `chatgpt_generate_image` | Create images, optionally from reference images |
| `chatgpt_edit_image` | Edit a chosen image; the original is kept |
| `chatgpt_view_image` | Describe images, read text in screenshots, compare images |
| `chatgpt_ask` | Analyze, translate, or write about text you provide |

The agent picks these tools on its own; you do not need to name them.

## Limits

- Calls use your ChatGPT account's Codex allowance.
- Images come from workspace files or images already in the session, up to five per call. Results are saved under `.dsh-chatgpt/` in the workspace, so creating or editing images needs write access.
- Older Codex versions are refused with a compatibility error.

## License

[SATA License 2.1](LICENSE)

# dsh-plugins

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) / English

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins by klarkxy. Browse them on the [plugin site](https://klarkxy.github.io/dsh-plugins/), which shows install commands and each plugin's documentation.

## Plugins

| Package | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-current-title`](plugins/dsh-current-title/README.md) | Auto Title: session titles follow the latest task; names you set by hand stay put. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-git-commit`](plugins/dsh-git-commit/README.md) | Git Commit: commit workspace changes from the conversation, with the model grouping the commits. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-safe-auto`](plugins/dsh-safe-auto/README.md) | Safe Auto: an independent reviewer model vets each sandbox escalation; only a pass auto-approves. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-session-manager`](plugins/dsh-session-manager/README.md) | Session Manager: find and read sessions across working directories, copy thread IDs, and use temporary workspaces. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-model-hub`](plugins/dsh-model-hub/README.md) | Model Hub: change the models used by your plugins and subagents from one page. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-web-search-manager`](plugins/dsh-web-search-manager/README.md) | Web Search: manage web search providers and public-page reading from one settings page. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-zhihu`](plugins/dsh-zhihu/README.md) | Zhihu: Zhihu search, agent tools, knowledge bases, and usage tracking. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-chatgpt`](plugins/dsh-chatgpt/README.md) | ChatGPT: search, image creation and editing, and image understanding through your local Codex. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-grok-build`](plugins/dsh-grok-build/README.md) | Grok Build: search, page reading, images, and video through your local Grok Build CLI. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-minimax-code`](plugins/dsh-minimax-code/README.md) | MiniMax Code: search, images, video, speech, and audio/video understanding through your local MiniMax Code. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-font`](plugins/dsh-font/README.md) | Font: customize the interface font, code font, and conversation font size of the Web GUI. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-unrestricted`](plugins/dsh-unrestricted/README.md) | Unrestricted: a session preset that delivers complete results, only in sessions that pick it. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-dev-index`](plugins/dsh-dev-index/README.md) | DSH Docs: read the official DSH docs in the Plugins page; Creator mode can look up docs and plugins. |
| [`dsh-plugin-autoevo`](https://github.com/klarkxy/dsh-plugin-autoevo#readme) | AutoEvo (deprecated): find, review, and install reusable capabilities; no longer maintained (separate repository). |

`@klarkxy/dsh-plugin-kit` and `@klarkxy/dsh-model-route` are shared libraries that other plugins install automatically.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @klarkxy/dsh-current-title
```

Replace `web` with your profile name and restart the profile after installing. Plugins that depend on others list the full install order on their site page.

## Development

Requires Node.js 24+ and pnpm 10.

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm check
```

The code is the developer documentation. Releases follow the [release guide](RELEASING.md).

## Plugin lifecycle

<!-- plugin-release-states:start -->
| Package | Lifecycle | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [@klarkxy/dsh-chatgpt](plugins/dsh-chatgpt/README.md) | Published (`published`) | Published on npm; subsequent versions follow the normal update workflow. |
| [@klarkxy/dsh-current-title](plugins/dsh-current-title/README.md) | Published (`published`) | Published on npm; fixes, testing and version updates keep the Published lifecycle. |
| [@klarkxy/dsh-dev-index](plugins/dsh-dev-index/README.md) | Published (`published`) | Published on npm; fixes, testing and version updates keep the Published lifecycle. |
| [@klarkxy/dsh-font](plugins/dsh-font/README.md) | Published (`published`) | Published on npm; fixes, testing and version updates keep the Published lifecycle. |

# Auto Title

<!-- release-state-note -->

[简体中文](docs/README.zh-CN.md)

Keeps each DeepSeek Harness session title on the task you are working on. A title you rename by hand is never overwritten.

```text
0903 | Fix | Login callback fails
```

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @klarkxy/dsh-current-title
```

Replace `web` with your profile name and restart it if DSH asks. Auto Title is enabled after installation and can be turned off in the plugin list.

## Use

Titles update automatically. Under **Plugins → Auto Title** you can:

- choose whether titles follow every message or only the first one;
- add your own title instruction;
- pick a title model (empty follows the current session model);
- regenerate the title of the open session.

## Limits

- Each title costs one model call; failed generations keep the existing title.
- Turning the plugin off hands titles back to the built-in DSH title feature.

## License

# DSH Docs

<!-- release-state-note -->

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Read the official DeepSeek Harness documentation without leaving DSH, and give Creator mode tools to look up the docs and check plugins before installing them.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @klarkxy/dsh-dev-index
```

Replace `web` with your profile name and restart the profile.

## Use

- **Plugins → DSH Docs** shows the [official documentation site](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) inside DSH, with a Chinese / English switch.
- In Creator mode the agent gets four read-only tools: `dsh_docs_search` and `dsh_docs_fetch` to find and read official docs, and `dsh_plugins_search` and `dsh_plugins_fetch` to check a plugin's npm information before installing it. Creator mode is also reminded to verify runtime interfaces with `cordis_inspect_list` and `cordis_inspect_query`.

## Limits

- The tools only read; they never install anything. Installing stays with the DSH plugin manager.
- The website follows the latest DSH release, which may differ from the version you run.
- npm metadata is not proof that a plugin works with your DSH.

## Install from GitHub

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:klarkxy/dsh-plugins#path:/plugins/dsh-dev-index"
```

A GitHub install builds the plugin locally, so pnpm first asks you to allow it. Add this to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml`, then run the command again:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  '@klarkxy/dsh-dev-index': true
```

## License

# Font

<!-- release-state-note -->

[简体中文](docs/README.zh-CN.md)

Change the interface font, code font, and conversation font size of the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @klarkxy/dsh-font
```

Replace `web` with your profile name, then restart the profile or reload the page.

## Use

Open **Plugins → Font**:

- **Interface font** and **Code font**: pick a preset, type any font name, or click **Load system fonts** to choose from fonts installed on this computer.
- **Conversation font size**: 10–22 px, kept in sync with **Settings → General**.

Changes apply immediately. Choose **Default** to go back to the DSH font.

## Limits

- **Load system fonts** works only in Chromium-based browsers and asks for permission.
- Font choices are saved in the current browser; set them again in another browser or address. The font size is saved by DSH.
- No fonts are bundled; the chosen font must be installed on the computer.

# Git Commit

<!-- release-state-note -->

[简体中文](docs/README.zh-CN.md)

Commit workspace changes without leaving the chat. A model groups your changes into a few sensible commits and writes their messages.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @klarkxy/dsh-git-commit
```

Replace `web` with your profile name and restart it if DSH asks.

## Use

1. Open a conversation whose workspace is inside a Git repository.
2. Click **Commit** in the top-right of the conversation.
3. Check the branch, file count, and model, then confirm.
4. The panel lists the commits it created.

Under **Plugins → Git Commit** you can choose the **Commit planning model** (empty follows the current session model) and turn on **Commit even without a model plan**, which makes one commit when the model is unavailable.

## Good to know

- All uncommitted changes in the repository are included, including new files.
- It only commits; it never pushes.
- If the run stops partway, finished commits stay and the panel shows what was left. Nothing is rolled back or retried automatically.
- The button is unavailable while the session is running.

# Grok Build

<!-- release-state-note -->

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Use the Grok Build CLI already signed in on your computer to search the web, read pages, create and edit images, and make videos from images.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @klarkxy/dsh-grok-build
```

Also install and sign in to the official Grok Build CLI. Only version 1.0.50 is supported for now. Open **Plugins → Grok Build**; if the CLI is not on PATH, enter its path.

## Tools

| Tool | Use it to |
| --- | --- |
| `grok_search` | Search the web with source links |
| `grok_fetch` | Read a page |
| `grok_generate_image` | Create images |
| `grok_edit_image` | Edit a workspace image or session attachment |
| `grok_image_to_video` | Animate an image |
| `grok_reference_to_video` | Make a video from reference images, a voice preset, or keyframes |
| `grok_media_jobs`, `grok_recover_media` | Find earlier results and fetch them again |

## Limits

- Image editing and video need **Allow Grok native tools to read media files** (off by default). This is an extra check, not a sandbox: Grok can read files as your local CLI normally can.
- Results are saved in the workspace, so a read-only workspace cannot create media.
- Cancelling stops the local process but may not stop generation on Grok's side; nothing is regenerated automatically.
- Not included: image understanding, X search, audio, or music.

# MiniMax Code

<!-- release-state-note -->

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Use the MiniMax Code app already signed in on your computer to search the web, create images, video, and speech, search images, transcribe audio, and understand audio and video. No API key is needed.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @klarkxy/dsh-minimax-code
```

Start and sign in to the official MiniMax Code desktop app, then open **Plugins → MiniMax Code**. Tool paths are found automatically; if both China and global versions are installed, choose one. Keep MiniMax Code running while you use the media tools.

## Tools

| Tool | Use it to |
| --- | --- |
| `minimax_search` | Search the web with source links |
| `minimax_generate_image` | Create or edit images from references |
| `minimax_search_images`, `minimax_reverse_image_search` | Find existing images, or search by image |
| `minimax_generate_video`, `minimax_video_status` | Start a video and check or download it later |
| `minimax_list_voices`, `minimax_synthesize_speech`, `minimax_batch_speech` | List voices and create speech |
| `minimax_transcribe_audio` | Transcribe recordings |
| `minimax_understand_audio`, `minimax_understand_video` | Ask questions about audio or video |
| `minimax_media_jobs`, `minimax_recover_media` | Find earlier results and fetch them again |

## Limits

- Video requires choosing a model. H3 models can add sound and use account credits; Hailuo 2.3 is a cheaper silent option. Actual costs follow your MiniMax account.
- Check video progress with `minimax_video_status` instead of submitting again.
- Inputs must be workspace files or session attachments. Results are saved under `.dsh-minimax-code/`, so a read-only workspace cannot create media.
- Cancelling stops the local process but may not stop generation on MiniMax's side.
- Not included: image understanding, X search, or music.

## License

[SATA License 2.1](LICENSE)

# dsh-plugins

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) / English

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins by klarkxy. Browse them on the [plugin site](https://klarkxy.github.io/dsh-plugins/), which shows install commands and each plugin's documentation.

## Plugins

| Package | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-current-title`](plugins/dsh-current-title/README.md) | Auto Title: session titles follow the latest task; names you set by hand stay put. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-git-commit`](plugins/dsh-git-commit/README.md) | Git Commit: commit workspace changes from the conversation, with the model grouping the commits. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-safe-auto`](plugins/dsh-safe-auto/README.md) | Safe Auto: an independent reviewer model vets each sandbox escalation; only a pass auto-approves. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-session-manager`](plugins/dsh-session-manager/README.md) | Session Manager: find and read sessions across working directories, copy thread IDs, and use temporary workspaces. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-model-hub`](plugins/dsh-model-hub/README.md) | Model Hub: change the models used by your plugins and subagents from one page. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-web-search-manager`](plugins/dsh-web-search-manager/README.md) | Web Search: manage web search providers and public-page reading from one settings page. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-zhihu`](plugins/dsh-zhihu/README.md) | Zhihu: Zhihu search, agent tools, knowledge bases, and usage tracking. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-chatgpt`](plugins/dsh-chatgpt/README.md) | ChatGPT: search, image creation and editing, and image understanding through your local Codex. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-grok-build`](plugins/dsh-grok-build/README.md) | Grok Build: search, page reading, images, and video through your local Grok Build CLI. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-minimax-code`](plugins/dsh-minimax-code/README.md) | MiniMax Code: search, images, video, speech, and audio/video understanding through your local MiniMax Code. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-font`](plugins/dsh-font/README.md) | Font: customize the interface font, code font, and conversation font size of the Web GUI. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-unrestricted`](plugins/dsh-unrestricted/README.md) | Unrestricted: a session preset that delivers complete results, only in sessions that pick it. |
| [`@klarkxy/dsh-dev-index`](plugins/dsh-dev-index/README.md) | DSH Docs: read the official DSH docs in the Plugins page; Creator mode can look up docs and plugins. |
| [`dsh-plugin-autoevo`](https://github.com/klarkxy/dsh-plugin-autoevo#readme) | AutoEvo (deprecated): find, review, and install reusable capabilities; no longer maintained (separate repository). |

`@klarkxy/dsh-plugin-kit` and `@klarkxy/dsh-model-route` are shared libraries that other plugins install automatically.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @klarkxy/dsh-current-title
```

Replace `web` with your profile name and restart the profile after installing. Plugins that depend on others list the full install order on their site page.

## Development

Requires Node.js 24+ and pnpm 10.

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm check
```

The code is the developer documentation. Releases follow the [release guide](RELEASING.md).

# Model Hub

<!-- release-state-note -->

[简体中文](docs/README.zh-CN.md)

See and change the models used by your DeepSeek Harness plugins from one page, and manage which models subagents may use.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @klarkxy/dsh-model-hub
```

Replace `web` with your profile name and restart the profile.

## Use

Open **Plugins → Model Hub**.

- **Fields**: every model setting exposed by installed plugins, such as Auto Title, Git Commit, Safe Auto, and ChatGPT. Search by plugin, purpose, or current model, then pick a new model. Changes are saved by the plugin that owns the setting.
- **Subagent Cast**: turn the subagent model allowlist on or off and add, replace, or remove models. You can give each model a short task tendency; the main agent reads it as a hint when choosing a subagent model, not as a rule.

## Limits

- Only plugins that expose model settings appear.
- If a setting changed elsewhere, refresh and choose again.
- No usage statistics.

## License

# Safe Auto

<!-- release-state-note -->

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Adds a **Safe Auto** permission level. When the agent asks to run a command or edit a file outside the sandbox, an independent reviewer model checks that one call. If it passes, the call goes ahead; otherwise you get 60 seconds to approve or reject it. Your session is never switched to Full Access.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @klarkxy/dsh-safe-auto
```

Replace `web` with your profile name and restart the profile.

## Use

Pick **Safe Auto** from the permission menu next to the chat input. It applies only to that session; choosing any other level turns it off. Nothing happens automatically until you pick it.

When a request does not pass review, a dialog shows the full action, the reviewer's opinion, and a countdown. Approve it once, or reject it. No answer means reject.

Under **Plugins → Safe Auto** you can choose the reviewer model (empty follows the current session model), its reasoning effort, and extra review rules.

## What it covers

- Sandbox escalations of `write`, `edit`, `bash`, and `pwsh`, one call at a time.
- A few clearly harmless shell commands, such as `ls` or `pwd`, are approved without a model call.
- Credential files, private keys, and dangerous programs are always refused.
- Other tools, MCP, remote execution, and subagents are not auto-approved.

## Limits

- **This is not a security boundary.** The reviewer is a language model and can be wrong. Keep your sandbox, isolation, and backups.
- Files can still change between approval and execution.
- Do not combine it with other automatic approvers.

# Session Manager

<!-- release-state-note -->

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Find and read DeepSeek Harness sessions across working directories, copy thread IDs, and start a chat in a temporary workspace.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @klarkxy/dsh-session-manager
```

Replace `web` with your profile name and restart the profile.

## Use

- **Agent tools**: `list_sessions`, `search_sessions`, and `read_session` let the agent find sessions by title or content and read a conversation, its full details, or a handoff summary. Reading a conversation returns one preview per turn, newest first; the agent pages further back with the returned cursor and opens full original content through details mode.
- **Copy thread ID**: from a session's menu, or press `Ctrl + Alt + C` (`⌘ + ⌥ + C` on macOS) for the open session.
- **Right-click menu**: right-clicking a session or workspace group in the sidebar opens the same menu as its **⋯** button.
- **Temporary workspace**: choose it in the new-session workspace picker to start a chat in its own new folder.

## Limits

- Temporary workspaces are not cleaned up automatically; their files stay after restarts and uninstall.
- Content read from other sessions is background information, not instructions.
- Free chats, deleting chats, and retrying or editing a sent message in place need a DSH host with these features. The npm plugin alone does not add them; the buttons appear only when the host supports them.

## License

# Unrestricted

<!-- release-state-note -->

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness session preset that delivers complete results directly, without watering them down or dodging. It only affects sessions where you choose it; every other preset stays exactly as it was.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @klarkxy/dsh-unrestricted
```

Replace `web` with your profile name and restart the profile.

## Use

Pick **Unrestricted** in the preset menu when creating a new session. A session that already has messages cannot switch presets. Subagents started from that session normally carry it too.

There is no switch to remember: choose the preset to use it, choose another preset to stop. It does not change your model, default preset, or permissions.

## Limits

- It unlocks no tools or permissions; approvals, sandbox, and plan mode work as usual.
- A subagent given its own persona does not carry the preset.
- To uninstall, remove the bundle from the plugin manager.

# Web Search

<!-- release-state-note -->

[简体中文](docs/README.zh-CN.md)

Choose which service answers the model's web searches, set request limits, and let the model read public web pages — all from one settings page.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @klarkxy/dsh-web-search-manager
```

Replace `web` with your profile name, restart DSH Web, and open **Plugins → Web Search**.

## Set up search

DuckDuckGo works out of the box with no key. You can also enable DeepSeek Search, Exa, Brave, Bocha, Serper, Firecrawl, or Tavily by entering their API keys. Drag the list to set the order; each search uses the first ready service. Search services added by other plugins, such as Zhihu, appear in the same list.

**Request limits** sets the number of results, queries per call, the total timeout, and the maximum page length.

## Read web pages

Turn on **Web fetch** to let the model read public pages. By default pages are read through the free Jina Reader, falling back to a direct request if that fails.

## Give the tools to the model

Add this to the plugin list of the `agent.cordis.yml` you use:

```yaml
- name: '@klarkxy/dsh-web-search-manager/tools'
```

The model then gets `web_search` and `web_fetch` while search and fetch are turned on.

## Limits

- Paid services may charge for searches; the plugin's counts are not a bill.
- Fetched page addresses are sent to Jina; do not fetch URLs containing private tokens.
- Failed searches do not switch to another service automatically.

# Zhihu

<!-- release-state-note -->

[简体中文](docs/README.zh-CN.md)

Use Zhihu as a research source for the model: site search, web search, the hot list, Zhida answers, knowledge bases, question discovery, and creator statistics. Every request uses your own Zhihu Access Secret. Results are reference material, not conclusions.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @klarkxy/dsh-zhihu
```

Replace `web` with your profile name and restart DSH Web. Use the full scoped name; the unscoped `dsh-zhihu` belongs to someone else.

## Use

Open **Plugins → Zhihu** and enter your Access Secret under **Settings**. The other tabs are:

- **Stats**: local daily calls, failures, and results;
- **Official quota**: your remaining free allowance as reported by Zhihu;
- **Knowledge base**: upload and search reference files;
- **Test**: run any search or query by hand.

With the Web Search plugin installed, Zhihu web search also appears in its provider list.

## Give the tools to the model

Add this to the plugin list of the `agent.cordis.yml` you use:

```yaml
- name: '@klarkxy/dsh-zhihu/tools'
```

The model then gets these tools:

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `zhihu_search`, `zhihu_global_search`, `zhihu_hot_list` | Zhihu search, web search, hot list |
| `zhihu_ask` | Zhida AI answers based on Zhihu content |
| `zhihu_knowledge_search` | Search knowledge bases |
| `zhihu_question_recommendations`, `zhihu_question_answers` | Find questions and read answer summaries |
| `zhihu_user_content_detail`, `zhihu_user_content_comments` | Read your own published content and its comments |
| `zhihu_creator_account_stats`, `zhihu_creator_content_stats` | Your creator statistics |
| `zhihu_quota` | Check official quota |

## Cost protection

By default the plugin only uses Zhihu's free allowance: before each request it checks the official quota and skips the request if none is left. It also stops after 100 requests per day (Beijing time). Both can be changed in the plugin configuration:

```yaml
config:
  allowPaid: false
  dailyCallLimit: 100
```

Paid use is allowed only when you set `allowPaid: true` yourself.

## Limits

- Zero cost is not guaranteed: other clients on the same account can use up the free allowance first.
- Uploaded files are stored on Zhihu's servers; do not upload unpublished manuscripts. Each file is limited to 20 MB.
- Requests are never retried automatically.
- Not included: OAuth account switching, top-ups, or wallet queries.

## License

[SATA License 2.1](LICENSE)

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# DSH 桌宠 · 大肥鱼

一只悬浮在桌面上的透明小宠物，**实时显示 DeepSeek Harness 中所有正在进行的任务**。
我正在思考时她托腮，执行工具时她转身拿齿轮干活，**卡在等你回答时她举手**，
**任务跑完时她庆祝**；同时跑着几个会话，她一次全列出来。

![七种状态](preview/states-7.png)

**特性**

- **七种状态**实时跟随 DSH 会话：空闲 / 思考中 / 执行中 / 等你回答 / 出错重试 / 已完成 / 离线
- **多会话并排**：同时跑几个任务时一次全列出来，不是只显示一个
- **真透明窗口**：`WS_EX_LAYERED` + `UpdateLayeredWindow` 做逐像素 alpha，边缘平滑、可拖拽
- **六套内置皮肤**，并支持两种第三方素材格式（Codex 精灵图契约 / clawd 主题）
- **隐私模式**：一键隐藏标题与提示词，只留状态
- **托盘图标 + 完成提示音**
- 纯 Python + Pillow，无网络、无遥测，只读 DSH 自己的会话文件

---

## 快速开始

```bash
git clone <本仓库>
cd desktop-pet
python dsh_pet.py
```

只依赖 **Python 3.10+** 和 **Pillow**（可选：`pystray` 托盘图标、`numpy` 用于 clawd 主题的 SVG 光栅化）。

Windows 上也可以双击 **`启动桌宠.vbs`**（静默启动，不弹控制台）；
出问题时用 **`调试启动.bat`** 看报错。

```bash
python dsh_pet.py --demo                 # 每 3 秒轮换状态，预览用
python dsh_pet.py --shot 前缀            # 不建窗口，把各状态渲染成 PNG
python dsh_pet.py --session <id>         # 只监视指定的一个会话
python dsh_pet.py --force-state tools    # 锁定某个状态
python dsh_pet.py --list-skins           # 列出可用皮肤
python dsh_pet.py --skin kun-like        # 指定皮肤启动
```

右键菜单可切换 **隐私模式**、**提示音**、**皮肤**；
左键单击 **戳一下**（角色会播一次反应动画）并展开详情卡，拖动可移动窗口。

---

## DSH 界面里的开关按钮

> ⚠️ **状态：Host 半已验证可用，客户端按钮尚未验证。**
> 插件会随 DSH 启动自动拉起桌宠，`/dsh-pet/status` 与 `/dsh-pet/toggle` 两条路由
> 实测返回正常；但侧边栏那个按钮目前**没有出现**，原因还在查
> （客户端模块图是否收录本包，需要看 `window.__DSH_BOOT__` 才能定位）。
> 也就是说：**自动启动能用，界面按钮还不能用。**

装了一个 DSH 插件，**在侧边栏底部（与「设置」同排）加一个爪印按钮**，
点击即可打开/关闭桌面宠物，按钮颜色反映运行状态：

| 按钮外观 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| 灰色爪印 | 桌宠未运行，点击打开 |
| 品牌色爪印 | 桌宠运行中，点击关闭 |
| 红色爪印 | 出错，悬停可看原因 |

按钮每 3 秒轮询一次状态，所以从桌宠那边右键退出，按钮也会跟着变灰。

### 随 DSH 启动

插件里带 `autostart`（默认开），所以 **DSH 一起来桌宠就自动出现**，不用手动点。
在补丁行里设 `autostart: false` 可关掉。

桌宠自身有**单实例锁**（绑本地端口 `51937`，进程退出时由系统自动释放）——
插件、快捷方式、手动启动三条路都走同一个入口，**不会叠出第二只**。

### 它是怎么接进 DSH 的

插件包在 [`dsh-plugin/`](dsh-plugin/)，是一个标准的 DSH bundle：

```
dsh-plugin/
├── package.json          dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 声明
├── cordis.patch.yml      把插件行插进 web 组合
└── lib/
    ├── index.js          Host 半：ctx.subprocess 管进程 + ctx.webServer 开路由
    └── client.js         Client 半：往 sidebar.footer.action 注册按钮
```

- **Host 半**用 `ctx.subprocess.spawn()` 启动桌宠（`pythonw.exe`，无控制台窗口），
  用 `handle.done` 跟踪退出，用 `handle.terminate()` 关闭
- **通信走 HTTP**，不走 typert Remote：Host 注册 `/dsh-pet/status` 与 `/dsh-pet/toggle`
  两条同源路由，浏览器侧 `fetch` 直接调用 —— Remote 需要生成式 schema，太重了
- **插件停用时会连带关掉桌宠**，不留孤儿进程

安装方式（已装好，这里是记录）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <插件目录>
```

⚠️ 注意：**Electron 桌面版独占管理 `desktop` profile**，CLI 会拒绝操作它。
本项目是直接把包链接到 `profiles/node_modules/`，并在
`profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` 里加了一行 insert —— 该文件就是用户补丁层，
且补丁是**热加载**的，改完无需重启。

---

## 七种状态

| 聚合状态 | 判定条件（DSH 投影缓存字段） | 形象 |
|---|---|---|
| 🟦 **空闲** | 没有任何会话在生成或跑工具 | 正面站立 |
| 🟪 **思考中** | `sessionStats.openStep` 存在 | 正面 + 三个跳动圆点 |
| 🟧 **执行中** | `sessionStats.pendingCalls` 非空 | **侧面**转身 + 旋转齿轮 |
| 🩷 **等你回答** | `userQuestions.questions.active` 非空 | 正面 + 粉色光晕 |
| 🟥 **出错重试** | `llmRetry` 非空 | 正面 + 红色光晕 |
| 🟩 **已完成** | `turnBoundary.openTurnStartSeq` 由非空转 null | 庆祝动作 |
| ⬜ **离线** | 找不到任何 DSH 会话 | **背面** |

**优先级**：等你回答 > 出错 > 执行 > 思考 > 已完成 > 空闲。
理由很实际 —— **卡在你这儿**是最该被看见的，所以它排第一。

「已完成」是**转换检测**出来的，不是某个字段的值：监视 `openTurnStartSeq`
从「有」变成 `null` 的那一刻，就认为那个会话刚跑完一个回合，庆祝 6 秒。

---

## 任务是怎么算的

**一个 DSH 会话算一个任务。** 桌宠扫描全部会话，把在跑的挑出来，按状态优先级排序后全部列出：

- **角色**显示**聚合状态** —— 只要有一个任务在跑工具，她就转身拿齿轮
- **折叠的信息卡**：单任务显示状态 + 工具名 + 耗时；
  多任务显示「N 个任务进行中」，下面逐行列出每个任务的标题、状态、耗时
- **展开的详情面板**：多任务时列出（最多 3 个，更多的折叠计数），
  再接主任务的模型、进度、token 与上下文条

排序规则是「按状态优先级，同类按开始时间」，因此列表顺序稳定，不会来回跳。

---

## 皮肤

仓库带**六套皮肤**，右键菜单可切换，**同时支持两种生态的素材格式**：

| 皮肤 | 来源 | 格式 | 授权 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **大肥鱼** | 内置 | 三视图 + 程序化姿态 | 本项目 |
| **kun-like** | [dsh-kun-like-pet](https://github.com/liyupi/dsh-kun-like-pet) | Codex 契约 `1536×1872` | MIT |
| **openpets** | [openpets](https://github.com/OpenPetsHQ/openpets) | Codex 契约扩展 `1536×2288` | MIT |
| **matcha-cheeky** | [MatchaDandan](https://github.com/CaptainRong/MatchaDandan) | Codex 契约扩展 `1536×2288` | MIT |
| **matcha-gentle** | 同上 | 同上 | MIT |
| **matcha-sunny** | 同上 | 同上 | MIT |

![Codex 契约皮肤](preview/skins-3.png)
![MatchaDandan 三画风](preview/skins-matcha.png)

> **为什么仓库里没有 clawd 主题素材？**
>
> 加载器支持 clawd 主题格式（代码在仓库里，MIT），但**素材一套都没打包**，原因是授权：
>
> | 主题 | 授权 | 为什么排除 |
> |---|---|---|
> | calico / cloudling | 美术**权利未明确** | 上游源码是 AGPL-3.0，但 README 明说该许可不自动适用于美术，也没单独授权。本地自用可以，**公开再分发是另一回事** |
> | 鲸鱼娘 Whale-chan | CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 | 许可允许非商业移植，但 **SA（相同方式共享）有传染性** —— 会要求整个衍生作品同样以 CC BY-NC-SA 发布，与本仓库的 MIT 冲突；体积也有 157MB |
> | 哈希仙人 Hash Sage | 保留全部权利 | 许可明确禁止 `use these materials in another project` |
>
> 所以**你自己放主题进去**就能用，见下一节。这不是技术限制，是授权边界。
> 完整说明见 [ATTRIBUTION.md](assets/ATTRIBUTION.md)。

### 格式一：Codex 桌宠精灵图契约

| 项目 | 规格 |
|---|---|
| 单格 | `192 × 208` |
| 网格 | 8 列；**至少 9 行** |
| 行定义 | 0 待机 · 1 向右跑 · 2 向左跑 · 3 挥手 · 4 跳跃 · 5 出错 · 6 等待回复 · 7 专注干活 · 8 思考审阅 |
| 行 9+ | 允许扩展（openpets 就多画了 2 行） |

放到下面任一目录即可被识别，**不用改代码**：

```
<程序目录>/assets/skins/<名称>/spritesheet.webp
~/.codex/pets/<名称>/spritesheet.webp        ← Codex 桌宠官方目录
```

### 格式二：clawd 主题

主题目录顶层放 `theme.json`，资源在 `assets/` 下：

```
<名称>/
  theme.json              ← 必需，含 states 映射
  assets/
    <状态>.apng / .svg / .gif / .webp / .png
```

扫描目录：

```
<程序目录>/assets/skins/clawd/<名称>/
%APPDATA%/clawd-on-desk/themes/<名称>/       ← clawd 的用户主题目录
```

**状态映射**（clawd 的状态名 → 本项目的 7 个状态）：

| 本项目 | clawd 状态（按优先级） |
|---|---|
| 空闲 | `idle` · `dozing` · `yawning` |
| 思考中 | `thinking` · `sweeping` |
| 执行中 | `working` · `carrying` · `juggling` |
| 等你回答 | `attention` · `notification` |
| 出错重试 | `error` |
| 已完成 | `notification` · `attention` |
| 离线 | `sleeping` · `collapsing` |

**资源格式支持情况**：

| 格式 | 支持 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| APNG / GIF / WebP / PNG / JPG | ✅ 完整 | Pillow 原生，**动画完整**，逐帧时长也读得到 |
| 静态 SVG | ✅ 完整 | 光栅化后使用 |
| **脚本驱动 SVG** | ⚠️ **仅静止帧** | 见下 |

### 关于脚本 SVG（重要限制）

clawd 的很多 SVG 是 **JS 驱动**的（cloudling 自称 "scripted SVG object-channel assets"），
动画由内嵌 `<script>` 在运行时算出来。光栅化只能拿到一帧静止画面，**那些部分会丢失**。
实测 cloudling：云朵角色、眼睛、出错态的 X 眼都在，但**打字的手、动作等只剩一团云**。

Calico 不受影响 —— 它只有 `idle` 用 SVG（且是眼球追踪用的 `-follow.svg`），
加载器会**自动换成同名的 APNG 兄弟文件**，所以动画是完整的。

### 三个实现细节

- **帧数不写死** —— Codex 契约数该行非空格子；clawd 主题用 Pillow 读 `n_frames`。
- **按内容框缩放** —— clawd 主题画布留白差异极大（calico 266×200、cloudling 88×72），
  按整图缩放角色会很小。改成按**所有帧的内容并集**裁切再缩放，
  用并集而不是逐帧裁切，角色才不会在帧间抖动。
- **SVG 透明背景** —— 本机没有 cairo（`cairosvg` 与 `reportlab` 的 renderPM 三个后端全缺），
  走 `svglib → PDF → pypdfium2`。PDF 渲染是不透明白底，于是**黑底白底各渲一次再解方程**：
  `alpha = 255 - max(白 - 黑)`、`color = 黑 / (alpha/255)`。

> ⚠️ 素材授权：clawd 的内置主题美术权利状态**未明确**（源码是 AGPL-3.0，
> 但 README 说该许可不自动适用于美术，也没单独授权）。哈希仙人**明确禁止**移植。
> 详见 [ATTRIBUTION.md](assets/ATTRIBUTION.md)。

---

## 隐私模式

学 [openpets](https://github.com/OpenPetsHQ/openpets) 的做法：**气泡里不放提示词、代码、路径**。

| | 普通模式 | 隐私模式 |
|---|---|---|
| 任务行标题 | 会话标题（由你的提问生成） | `会话 1` / `会话 2` |
| 副行文案 | 提示词片段 | 「模型正在生成」等通用文案 |

右键菜单或 `--privacy` 切换，状态存在 `pet_config.json`。

![隐私模式对比](preview/privacy-preview.png)

---

## 托盘图标与提示音

- **托盘图标**：桌宠被窗口挡住时，托盘仍显示当前状态（图标 = 该状态首帧缩到 64px，
  悬停提示显示状态名）。托盘菜单可显示/隐藏桌宠、切换详情、隐私模式、退出。
- **提示音**：任务跑完时播一声系统提示音（`SystemAsterisk`）。
  多个任务同时完成只响一次（3 秒去重）。

两者都可在右键菜单里关掉。

---

## 状态是怎么读到的

桌宠不修改 DSH，也不装插件 —— 它只**只读**两份 DSH 自己写的文件：

**1. 会话投影缓存**（主要来源，明文 JSON）

```
<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/session-<id>.json
```

| 字段 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `rows.sessionStats.val.openStep` | `{turn, step, startTime, firstTokenTime}`，非 null = 正在生成 |
| `rows.sessionStats.val.pendingCalls` | `{callId: 开始时间}`，非空 = 有工具在跑 |
| `rows.userQuestions.val.questions.active` | 非空 = 有提问在等你回答 |
| `rows.llmRetry.val` | 非空 = 请求出错正在重试 |
| `rows.turnBoundary.val.openTurnStartSeq` | 非 null = 回合进行中；转 null = 刚跑完 |
| `rows.inbox.val` | `next-turn` / `next-step` 非空 = 有排队中的消息 |
| `rows.plan.val.active` | 处于计划模式 |
| `rows.goal.val.current.goal.objective` | 该会话的长期目标 |
| `rows.modelSelection.val.lastUsed` | 当前 provider / model |
| `rows.contextPressure.val` | 上下文占用与窗口大小 |
| `rows.tokenUsage.val.totals` | 累计输出 token |
| `rows.title.val` / `rows.turnOutline.val` | 会话标题 / 当前提示词 |

**2. 会话事件日志**（只为拿工具名）

```
<DSH_HOME>/sessions/*/session-<id>/session*.jsonl.zstd
```

这是追加写的 zstd 流，且 **Python 无法持续持有解压流**（实测 `decompressobj` 不可复用、
`stream_reader` 不会读到后续追加的数据）。因此按 **zstd 帧魔数** `28 B5 2F FD` 切分，
逐帧独立解压，只解上次之后新增的帧 —— 每轮开销恒定，不受日志总长影响。

从 `tool/call` 事件里取 `callId → name`，就能把 `pendingCalls` 里的 callId 还原成
`pwsh` / `read` / `grep` 这样的工具名。

**多会话**：每次轮询都会扫描全部会话文件，把所有「生成中 / 跑工具中」的都收集起来。
投影缓存按 **mtime + size** 缓存，文件没变就不重新解析 ——
实测 10 个会话下，一轮轮询中位 **0.8ms**、最差 14ms，远低于 350ms 的轮询间隔。

工具名只为**活跃会话**建增量日志读取器（空闲会话用不上），
并限制最多保留 6 个，避免读遍所有会话的事件日志。

用 `--session` 可以锁定单个会话；右键菜单的「自动跟随活跃会话」可以解除锁定。

---

## 交互

| 操作 | 效果 |
|---|---|
| 左键拖动 | 移动位置（自动记忆） |
| 单击 | 展开 / 收起详情面板 |
| 右键 | 菜单：详情、自动跟随、复制会话 ID、**隐私模式**、**提示音**、**皮肤**、退出 |
| 托盘图标 | 显示/隐藏桌宠、切详情、切隐私、退出 |

位置、详情展开、隐私、提示音、皮肤都存在 `pet_config.json`。

---

## 实现要点

**逐像素透明窗口**。tkinter 本身做不到，所以用 `WS_EX_LAYERED` +
`UpdateLayeredWindow` 直接推送带 alpha 的 32 位位图，得到边缘平滑的真透明，
而不是 `-transparentcolor` 那种抠色（会有色边）。

两个踩过的坑，都写在代码注释里：

- `UpdateLayeredWindow` 的 `pptDst` 参数**会移动窗口**。传坐标进去的话，
  每帧都把窗口搬到那个坐标，Tk 设置的 `geometry` 全被覆盖 —— 必须传 `NULL`。
- 预乘 alpha 不要用 Python 逐像素循环（每帧 5 万次迭代太慢）。
  用 `ImageChops.multiply` 逐通道乘 alpha，再让 PIL 以 `"BGRA"` 原始模式吐字节。

**动画**。素材是三张静态三视图，动感靠变换做：呼吸（纵向缩放）、
弹跳、轻微旋转、状态光晕、配件旋转 —— 全部帧预渲染后缓存，
每帧只做合成与推送，CPU 开销很低。

**降级**：万一分层窗口不可用，会退回 `-transparentcolor` 方案并打印警告。

---

## 文件

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `dsh_pet.py` | 主程序（状态读取 + 渲染 + 窗口，单文件） |
| `assets/` | 角色三视图素材 + `skins/` 契约皮肤包，来源与授权见 [ATTRIBUTION.md](assets/ATTRIBUTION.md) |
| `dsh-plugin/` | DSH 插件包（Host + Client 半 + bundle 补丁），提供界面开关按钮 |
| `启动桌宠.vbs` | 静默启动器（不装插件时用） |
| `调试启动.bat` | 带控制台启动，用于排查 |
| `pet_config.json` | 位置与偏好（自动生成） |
| `preview/` | 各状态渲染图与实机截图 |

---

## 已知限制

**状态有 3~5 秒延迟。** 实测 DSH 的投影缓存不是工具一发就开始就更新的：

```
t=0.0s  pendingCalls={}                      openStep=step 71   ← 工具已在跑
t=2.5s  pendingCalls={}                      openStep=step 71   ← 投影仍未更新
t=5.0s  pendingCalls={call_00_ecsx...}       openStep=None      ← 才切到"执行中"
```

所以**短于约 5 秒的工具调用可能捕捉不到**，桌宠会一直显示「思考中」。
这是读取投影缓存的固有限制，不是渲染问题。

**只反映本机会话。** 读的是本地 DSH 数据目录；远程或容器里的 DSH 看不到。

**一个会话 = 一个任务。** DSH 的投影缓存里，子代理（`subagentCatalog`）几乎是空的、
后台任务（jobs）则完全没有暴露，所以同一个会话内并行跑的子代理不会各自成行 ——
它们都算在那个会话这一个任务里。这也是为什么 clawd-on-desk 那种「多个子代理时抛接」
的动作，本项目**做不到**：数据源里没有这个粒度。

**三个新状态的实测程度不同，如实说明：**

| 状态 | 数据来源 | 验证程度 |
|---|---|---|
| 已完成 | `turnBoundary.openTurnStartSeq` | ✅ **两种状态都实测到**（有值 / null） |
| 等你回答 | `userQuestions.questions.active` | ⚠️ 结构已确认，只见过空值，**未见过非空** |
| 出错重试 | `llmRetry` | ⚠️ 同上 |

也就是说「等你回答」与「出错重试」的**判定逻辑是照字段结构写的，尚未在真实触发时观察过**。
等你实际遇到（我向你提问时、或模型重试时）可以看一眼是否如期亮起。
渲染与状态机本身已用 `--shot` 逐一验证。

**不打扰 DSH。** 全程只读，不改配置、不发请求、不注册插件。

---

## 素材与致谢

- 角色形象「鲸鱼娘·大肥鱼」来自 [1190fasheqi/dafeiyu-pet](https://github.com/1190fasheqi/dafeiyu-pet)（MIT）
- 契约皮肤 `assets/skins/kun-like/` 来自 [liyupi/dsh-kun-like-pet](https://github.com/liyupi/dsh-kun-like-pet)（MIT）

素材均已由上游做过抠图与边缘去污，本项目直接使用，详见 [assets/ATTRIBUTION.md](assets/ATTRIBUTION.md)。

同类项目参考：

- [liyupi/dsh-kun-like-pet](https://github.com/liyupi/dsh-kun-like-pet) —— DSH Cordis 插件形态
- [CLICGGER-TYPES/dsh-piggy](https://github.com/CLICGGER-TYPES/dsh-piggy) —— 插件 + Electron 双形态
- [rullerzhou-afk/clawd-on-desk](https://github.com/rullerzhou-afk/clawd-on-desk) —— 状态机设计参考
- [OpenPetsHQ/openpets](https://github.com/OpenPetsHQ/openpets) —— 隐私原则参考
- [ntd4996/agentpet](https://github.com/ntd4996/agentpet) —— 托盘状态显示参考

本项目走的是第三条路：**独立进程 + 只读投影缓存**，不需要装插件、不改动 DSH。

# dsh-cad — CAD Plugin for DeepSeek Harness

![dsh-cad banner](docs/img/banner.svg)

[![homepage](https://img.shields.io/badge/homepage-dsh--cad-4D6BFE)](https://lau-mars.github.io/dsh-cad/)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@deepseek-ai%2Fdsh?label=dsh)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D%2022-4D6BFE)](https://nodejs.org/)
[![occt](https://img.shields.io/badge/occt-7.9.3-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/LAU-MARS/opencascade-ts)
[![occt.ts](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/occt.ts?label=occt.ts)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/occt.ts)
[![ansatz](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/ansatz-wasm?label=ansatz)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ansatz-wasm)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4D6BFE)](./LICENSE)

English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A CAD plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
an **embedded 3D/2D CAD viewer** plus a **native parametric modeling tool family**
(OCCT kernel) in the Web UI, letting the agent build and inspect CAD geometry
step by step — "model while you watch".

## Preview

A full modeling session, end to end: the agent builds a parametric assembly
from plain chat — a 120×80×8 base plate with R5 rounded corners, then four
bolt instances placed at the corners — while the resident CAD panel tracks
every step live (parts tree with per-instance colors, ViewCube, "装配体"
assembly tab, 5 instances · 1,740 triangles). The finished assembly exports
as a structured STEP document and the agent verifies it by reading the file
back — 2 solids, 3 products, 2 assembly usages, 1,125.00 mm³:

![dsh-cad assembly session](docs/img/assembly-preview.png)

## Downloads

Cumulative downloads from the npm registry, refreshed daily by CI:

![npm cumulative downloads](docs/img/downloads-cumulative.svg)

## Feature Overview

| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| ⚙️ Single-kernel architecture | **occt.ts as the primary modeling kernel** (true B-splines, native shell/draft, centroid); opencascade.js stays only as the fallback backend; the old "no editing after shell" seam is gone — fillet/chamfer/boolean keep working after shelling |
| 🔍 CAD viewing | STL / OBJ / STEP / IGES / BREP / DCPRT (3D), DXF / SVG (2D); interactive viewport in the resident right panel (orbit / zoom / wireframe / pan), with a one-line result row in the conversation |
| 🧭 CAD editor interactions | Onshape-style ViewCube (26-zone click-to-orient), hover/click face & edge picking with live measurement (area mm² / length mm), Faces+Edges / Faces / Wireframe render modes, switchable BRep demo parts (bracket / flange / shaft) |
| 🏗️ Parametric modeling | Primitives, profile extrusion, **loft**, **sweep**, **revolve**, booleans, all-edge fillet/chamfer, **shell**, **draft**, **patterns** (linear/circular), transforms; profiles take **curve segments** (arcs/circles exact BRep; B-splines sampled approximation) — exact OCCT BRep, not a mesh approximation |
| ✏️ Named sketches | Standalone named profiles (Sketch1…) kept in the document (`cad_sketch_new` / `edit` / `list` / `delete`); extrude/revolve/sweep reference them **by name**, and `cad_sketch_edit` rewrites the definition in place + replays the log, rebuilding every dependent feature — the parametric loop. Sketches render as Onshape-style **blue curves + plane frame** in the viewport (refreshing live on edit), listed in a left-side **feature tree** (sketches + features, eye-toggle visibility, click-to-highlight bodies) over the Part tab |
| 🗂️ Codex-style document tabs | The resident display panel gets a tab strip with a "+" menu: **Part** (Part Studio, the default) / **Assembly** (instance insert/move/remove) / **Drawing** (true hidden-line sheets); tabs are closable and keep their state |
| 📁 Multi-document file space | Named documents per workspace (`.dsh-cad/docs/`), each session bound to its own active document — new sessions start empty instead of inheriting leftovers; a folder button in the panel lists every document (preview / delete), and `cad_doc_new` / `cad_doc_open` manage the modeling target from chat |
| 📐 Engineering drawings | GB first-angle layout: front / top / left views + isometric, true OCCT hidden-line removal via the **occt.ts** kernel (an npm dependency, dashed); sheet frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale series; exports SVG / DXF |
| 🔗 Constraint solving & motion | **Ansatz** geometric constraint solver (**one command: `npm install ansatz-wasm`** — a wasm dependency, no Rust toolchain, no native binary): entity/constraint modeling (assembly instances ↔ rigid3 poses mapped automatically), solve-with-writeback, full DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics (LLM-oriented), and parametric kinematic sweeps (`cad_constraint` / `cad_solve` / `cad_motion`) |
| 📐 Geometry measurement | Exact volume (mm³), bounding box, triangle counts, DXF layers |
| 📤 On-demand export | STEP (parametric) / STL (mesh); files are written only when the user asks |
| 🖥️ Resident CAD panel | A permanent panel right of the conversation: Codex-style tabs (Part / Assembly / Drawing), tracking the latest model in real time while modeling |
| ⚡ Zero-copy render pipeline | worker mesh → in-memory binary → three.js typed arrays; zero base64 / zero intermediate files / zero per-step disk writes |
| 💾 Modeling document persistence | Operation log (JSON) + debounced disk mirror; automatically replayed to restore state after a process restart |
| 🖼️ Image → profile | PNG sketch/screenshot → Otsu binarization → contour tracing → extrusion-ready polygon (`cad_image_profile`) |
| 🔌 FreeCAD executor | Run the same op family on an external FreeCAD console (STEP in/out); requires a local FreeCAD install |
| ☁️ Onshape executor | Run the same op family on **Onshape** over its signed REST API — zero local install; every op compiles to a **standard Onshape feature** pushed into the target Part Studio (no Feature Studio setup). Readback is three-tier: cheap per-part STL by default, `readback: "step"` for exact-BRep-derived named meshes via a server-side STEP translation, or `readback: "none"` — build only and return the document link (~3 calls, quota-friendliest). Exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid). Quota-aware errors distinguish credential problems from free-plan cooldowns; the Onshape document URL is always surfaced |

## Installation

The plugin is published to npm — one line:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cad
```

The installer applies the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` (declared in the `dsh.bundle` manifest) automatically, so there is nothing to configure by hand.

### Version requirements

- **Node.js** and **dsh CLI** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`): minimum versions live in
  the badge row above and the `engines` field of `package.json` — kept out of
  the prose so they never go stale

### Install from source (dev mode)

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LAU-MARS/dsh-cad.git
cd dsh-cad
npm install && npm run build && npm test   # deps include occt.ts (true-HLR drawing kernel, ~20MB wasm)

npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh pnpm
dsh web                                  # let the first launch init the profile, then Ctrl-C

dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-cad

dsh web
```

The patch insert ships as `cordis.patch.yml` in the package root and is applied by the installer via the same `dsh.bundle` manifest.

Set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` and you are ready — for example:

- “open bracket.stl” → `cad_view`
- “model a 100×60×5 plate, punch a ⌀20 hole in the middle, R2 fillets on the four
  corners, add a ⌀16 boss 20 tall, export plate.step”
  → `cad_create_prim` + `cad_boolean` + `cad_fillet` + `cad_export`, with the 3D tab
  updating live at every step
- “build a snowman” → spheres + a cone nose + a cylinder hat (precise `at`/`axis` placement)
- “add two more b1, one rotated 90 degrees” → `cad_assembly_insert` + `cad_assembly_move`, the Assembly tab updates live
- “make an A3 drawing of b1 and export dxf” → `cad_drawing` (three views + iso + dashed hidden lines + dimensions) → `cad_export` `.dxf`

## Modeling Tool Family

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cad_view` | Open a CAD file and render it in the viewer (resident panel) |
| `cad_info` | Read-only geometry metadata (format / counts / bounding box / units / layers) |
| `cad_create_prim` | Primitives (mm, Z-up); `at` for placement, `axis` for orientation (exact axis-angle rotation) |
| `cad_sketch_new` | Create a named sketch (Sketch1…): {start, segments} / {circle} / flat points loop — referenced by name from the profile features |
| `cad_sketch_edit` | Redefine a sketch (回改): the definition op is rewritten in place and the log replayed — every referencing feature rebuilds |
| `cad_sketch_list` | List the document's sketches (name / form / size) |
| `cad_sketch_delete` | Delete a sketch (refused while features still reference it) |
| `cad_extrude_profile` | Extrude a closed XY-plane profile along +Z into a solid — inline points/segments/circle or a named sketch (`sketch`) |
| `cad_loft` | Loft: skin a solid through successive closed sections (each a [x,y,z,…] loop in its own plane); sections may differ in shape and point count; `ruled` for straight sides |
| `cad_revolve` | Solid of revolution: revolve a closed profile around an axis (profile coords = (radius, height); curve segments supported — rounded rims exact); optional `angle`; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_chamfer` | Chamfer: bevel every sharp edge with one equal distance (mm) |
| `cad_pattern` | Pattern: linear (`delta` spacing) or circular (principal axis + `at` point + sweep angle); creates copy bodies, fuse afterwards for one body |
| `cad_shell` | Shell: hollow to a wall thickness (inward, outer skin preserved); `open` lists outward normals of the faces to open (empty = sealed). Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_draft` | Draft: tilt the walls `angle` degrees about a neutral plane (mold release); `direction` is the pull direction, walls auto-selected by default. Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_sweep` | Sweep: pipe a closed 2D profile along a 3D [x,y,z,…] path; the profile is auto-placed on the start plane, so no manual orientation; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_boolean` | fuse / cut / common (classic hole punching: plate cut cylinder) |
| `cad_fillet` | Constant-radius fillet on all sharp edges |
| `cad_transform` | Translate / Euler rotate / mirror |
| `cad_volume` | Exact BRep volume (mm³) |
| `cad_drawing` | Engineering drawing: front/top/left + isometric views, dashed hidden lines, frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale, A4/A3 |
| `cad_assembly_insert` | Insert a body into the assembly as a placed instance (`at` position, `rotate` orientation) |
| `cad_assembly_move` | Set an instance's absolute placement |
| `cad_assembly_remove` | Remove an instance from the assembly (the body stays) |
| `cad_constraint` | Declare the constraint model: entities (assembly-instance bindings) + constraints (distance/angle/mate/coaxial…), persisted in the op log |
| `cad_solve` | Solve with Ansatz and write poses back; returns DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics |
| `cad_motion` | Kinematic sweep: drive one constraint value from `from` to `to`, solve frame by frame, apply the last pose, return the motion table |
| `cad_export` | Export STEP / STL / DCPRT (the native replayable part document) to a workspace path; `target: "assembly"` writes the assembly STEP, `target: "drawing"` writes the sheet as SVG / DXF |
| `cad_delete` | Delete a body |
| `cad_docs` | List the workspace's modeling documents (id / name / bodies / updated, active marked) |
| `cad_doc_new` | Create a named document and make it the session's modeling target (start multi-part projects here) |
| `cad_doc_open` | Open an existing document (by id or name) as the session's modeling target — bodies replay exactly |
| `cad_doc_rename` | Rename a document |
| `cad_doc_delete` | Permanently delete a document (requires `confirm: true`) |
| `cad_freecad` | Run an op program on an external FreeCAD executor (optional STEP input / export) |
| `cad_fusion` | Run an op program on an external Fusion 360 executor (GUI bridge; optional export) |
| `cad_onshape` | Run an op program on the Onshape cloud (signed REST API): creates or drives a document, returns its URL; `readback: "step"` for exact BRep meshes; exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid) |
| `cad_image_profile` | PNG → contours → extrusion-ready polygon points |
| `cad_script` | Deterministic script evaluation for geometry math (profile point arrays, arc coordinates): `js` runs in-process (Node vm — works even when the host shell is unavailable), `py` uses a system Python |

After every modeling step: **the chat result row updates in place** (stable viewId +
versioned URL), and the resident panel's "Part" tab tracks the latest model in real time.

## Connectors (roadmap)

Modeling primarily runs on the **occt.ts kernel** (opencascade.js as the fallback backend) (OCCT in the browser —
zero install). The connectors below refer to **external CAD engines** acting as
executors for the same tool family, planned for future support:

| Connector | Suite | Platform | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Built-in kernel** | CAD modeling kernel based on OCCT + WebGL, runs in the browser — zero install | All platforms (WebGL rendering) | ✅ Built-in |
| FreeCAD | open-source parametric suite — natural local executor via its Python API (console + GUI window modes) | Windows / macOS / Linux | ✅ Available (needs local install) |
| Fusion 360 | Autodesk CAD/CAM — resident add-in + spool bridge (no headless; the Fusion window doubles as a viewer) | Windows / macOS | 🧪 Experimental (`cad_fusion`) |
| SolidWorks | Dassault Systèmes industry-standard 3D CAD, COM/.NET automation | Windows only | 🚧 Windows demo scaffold (`scripts/solidworks-bridge/`) |
| Onshape | PTC cloud-native SaaS CAD, fully in the browser — signed REST API (cad.onshape.com or chamber hosts); every op compiles to a standard Onshape feature pushed into the Part Studio, results read back as per-part STL + mass properties, the cloud is the viewer | All platforms (browser) | ✅ Available (`cad_onshape`; set `DSH_ONSHAPE_ACCESS_KEY` / `DSH_ONSHAPE_SECRET_KEY`) |
| ZW3D（中望3D） | ZWSOFT all-in-one CAD/CAM | Windows / Linux | 🚧 Planned |
| GstarCAD 3D（浩辰3D） | Gstarsoft 3D CAD | Windows | 🚧 Planned |

All external engines implement the same **GeometryExecutor contract** (`available()` /
`run(opProgram) → meshes`), so the WebGL display layer never changes — swapping a
backend changes only the quality of the produced geometry.

## Architecture

```
cad_view(path)                        modeling tools (cad_create_prim, …)
  → import worker (occt-import-js)      → modeling worker (opencascade.js WASM)
  → CadScene JSON (base64-f32)          → exact BRep geometry + meshing
  → GET /dsh-cad/scene/<id>            → in-memory binary scene (f32/u32 packed)
                                        → GET /dsh-cad/bin/<docId>
            ↓ session presentationMeta (viewId + versioned URL) ↓
        browser card + persistent "3D" tab (three.js / SVG, Z-up, XYZ axes)
```

- **Two workers**: import (occt-import-js, read-only STEP/IGES/BREP) and modeling
  (opencascade.js, full OCCT) are separate, both lazily started; the `_N`
  suffix convention of embind overloaded constructors is wrapped in
  `src/modeling/occt-adapter.cjs` (all verified at runtime)
- **Zero-copy pipeline**: modeling scenes use zero base64 / zero large JSON arrays /
  zero per-step disk writes (disk mirror debounced 1.5s, replayed only on service
  restart); `cad_export` is the only explicit file export
- **Modeling document**: `<workspace>/.dsh-cad/model.json` operation log; all bodies
  are restored by replay after a restart
- **Drawing HLR kernel**: hidden lines run on **occt.ts** (npm dependency,
  `npm i occt.ts`) — true OCCT removal, no fallback engine, a missing kernel is
  a hard error. New APIs over opencascade.js: `hiddenLines()` true hidden-line
  removal, byte-level STEP/BRep `readStep`/`readBrep`/`writeStep`/`writeBrep`
  without MEMFS, tessellation with built-in feature-edge extraction, and a
  `hasError()`/`lastError()` error contract. Geometry crosses kernels as STEP
  bytes and the projected segments are remapped into the sheet frame. Kernel
  dist resolution: `DSH_OCCTJS_DIST` env var → Node's own resolution of the
  `occt.ts` dependency (walks up every parent node_modules — npm/yarn flat and
  pnpm symlink layouts all hit) → `<repo>/../opencascade-ts/dist` (sibling
  checkout) → `vendor/` → `node_modules/opencascade-ts`
- **Constraint solving (Ansatz)**: the solver is the npm dependency
  **`ansatz-wasm`** (a wasm-bindgen build, single package ~538KB, zero deps) —
  installing dsh-cad pulls it automatically, and `npm install ansatz-wasm` alone
  upgrades it. **No Rust toolchain, no native binary, platform independent.**
  Resolution: the npm package (node_modules) → a `DSH_ANSATZ_WASM` directory → a
  sibling Ansatz checkout's pkg-node. The solver speaks one JSON envelope
  contract, with tool-layer errors (e.g. `unsupported_constraint`) surfaced
  verbatim for the LLM. Assembly placements (translate + XYZ Euler
  degrees) map bidirectionally to the solver's rigid3 poses (translate +
  exponential-map rotation, radians). Solver capability is staged
  (point-distance-to-origin today) — the plumbing contract is finished and needs
  no changes as it grows
- **Single-kernel architecture**: the primary modeling kernel is
  **occt.ts** — primitives, curve-segment profiles (TRUE B-spline
  interpolation), loft/sweep/revolve, booleans, fillet/chamfer, shell/draft,
  mirror (composed as scale(-1) + a π rotation) and centroid all live in one
  session; engineering-drawing HLR takes the shape directly (zero STEP hops);
  editing after shelling is seamless (the old hosted-body seam is deleted).
  opencascade.js remains as the FALLBACK backend (auto-selected when occt.ts
  cannot load). Assembly STEP export writes a **structured document** (occt.ts
  `writeStepDocument`): one root product plus one named, placed child
  per instance — instance separation survives the file (STL stays a single
  fused mesh; the fallback backend also fuses). Instance separation stays in
  the assembly scene/document for the fuse paths.
  Face selection matches `describe()` plane normals (outermost along ±normal)
- **Client**: esbuild single-file CJS factory (three.js inlined ~560KB, react provided
  by the host module table), Z-up CAD convention, empty scene with XYZ axis labels
  and a ground grid always displayed

## Tests

```sh
npm test                             # full suite: converters / modeling worker (exact volume assertions) / DCPRT round-trip / FreeCAD + Onshape executors / image profiles / binary pipeline / document persistence
node test/m0-kernel-check.cjs        # OCCT kernel API smoke test
node test/route-check.mjs            # JSON scene routing layer
node test/visual/serve.mjs           # browser card/tab visual verification page (http://127.0.0.1:3987)
```

Representative assertions covered: the boolean-punched volume exactly equals the
analytic value (28429.20 mm³), L-shaped profile extrusion 3000 mm³, volumes and
bounding-box flips of sphere/cone/torus placed with `at`/`axis`, 8-byte alignment
of the binary packing, an STL export round-trip (export → read back by the
phase-1 parser), and a DCPRT document round-trip (serialize → replay on the
OCCT worker → exact bounds).

## Known Limitations

- DWG (closed-source) is unsupported; DXF bulge arcs are approximated by chords;
  glTF/3MF viewing is not implemented (the structure is reserved)
- `cad_fillet` is all-edge constant-radius (per-edge selection is unstable under
  embind); chamfer is not implemented
- Sketch extrusion supports polygon profiles only (arc profiles are constructed by
  boolean combinations of cylinders/tori)
- dsh framework limitation: an already-mounted single slot (the right-side details
  panel itself) does not respond to components registered later, so the persistent
  view is provided as the "3D" view tab (a list slot, the official composition)
- The host reads CAD files via node:fs (the platform fs service supports UTF-8 text
  only and cannot carry binary data)

## Community

| QQ Group (🇨🇳 China) | Feishu (🇨🇳 China) | X / Twitter (🌍 International) | Discord (🌍 International) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `485038246` (join note: dsh-cad) | 🚧 Coming soon | 🚧 Coming soon | 🚧 Coming soon |

# dsh-coreldraw

DeepSeek Harness 的 CorelDRAW 自动化插件。JavaScript 注册工具并校验输入，C# 在专用 STA 线程中调用 CorelDRAW COM 对象。无需 Python、VBA 宏或额外的 CorelDRAW 插件。

## 安装

在 Harness 官方插件管理入口添加：

```text
github:leolee9086/dsh-coreldraw#main
```

包内的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 注册工具，不需要修改 agent 预设。安装后按 Harness 提示重新加载宿主。先调用 `corel_instances` 查看实例，使用返回的 `pid` 和 `instance_id` 调用 `corel_connect`，再用 `corel_documents` 验证文档。默认只附着已有实例；只有未发现现存实例时，`launch:true` 才允许启动软件。

发现同时读取 CorelDRAW 窗口和 COM 运行对象表。某些版本不注册 Application 活动对象，但会注册已打开的 CDR 文档；插件通过文档的明确 COM 接口找到所属应用，再核对窗口对应的进程。多个实例时需要显式选择，选择失败不会切换连接，实例切换会使旧文档 ID 失效。`instance_id` 包含进程创建时间，用于识别 PID 重用。

Windows 安全上下文会影响运行对象表的可见范围。例如，沙箱启动的测试实例和普通桌面实例可能互不可见。`connectable:false` 表示窗口存在，但当前进程不能取得其 COM 对象；诊断保留 HRESULT。应在实际 Harness 宿主中验收，而不是把独立沙箱脚本的发现结果当作宿主结果。未保存文档且 Application 未注册的实例也可能只能发现窗口；插件不会为取得连接而另开一份原文档。

## 系统与依赖

- Windows x64、.NET Framework 4.8、已安装且正常注册 COM 的 CorelDRAW。
- 固定依赖 `edge-js@26.1.0` 与 `electron-edge-js@44.0.0`，根据实际宿主选择其一，绝不把 Node 原生模块加载进 Electron。
- 本机桥接已实测 Node 22.19 / ABI 127、Harness Electron 44 / ABI 149。依赖包还带有 Node 20/24/26、Electron 39–43 的预编译产物，但这些运行时尚未逐个验收；项目要求 Node >=22.19。
- 安装允许 `--ignore-scripts`，不需要 node-gyp、Visual Studio Build Tools、.NET SDK 或 Electron rebuild。不要关闭 optional dependencies，否则桥接包会缺失。
- 原生二进制、VC 运行库以及 `edge-cs.dll`、`edge-cs-base.dll` 从本包的依赖范围解析，按内容哈希缓存。代码不依赖开发机目录，也不修改全局 `EDGE_NATIVE` / `EDGE_CS_NATIVE`。
- 编译器缓存需要可写的 ASCII 路径。默认尝试临时目录及 ProgramData；中文用户名且默认目录不可写时，可将 `CORELDRAW_CACHE_DIR` 或插件 `cacheDir` 配置为一个自己可写的 ASCII 目录。错误会明确指出需要设置的位置。

## 工具

| 工具 | 功能 |
| --- | --- |
| `corel_instances` | 发现实例，返回 PID、实例标识、窗口标题、可连接状态及诊断 |
| `corel_connect` | 按 PID 和实例标识连接；可指定活动对象探针的 ProgID |
| `corel_documents` | 列出文档，取得绑定实际 COM 文档的 ID |
| `corel_create` | 新建指定毫米尺寸的空白文档 |
| `corel_inspect` | 读取当前页、图形、文字及编辑令牌 |
| `corel_apply` | 批量创建矩形、椭圆、段落文字；移动、缩放、旋转、填色、改字、删除 |
| `corel_undo` | 撤销指定文档最近一条命令 |
| `corel_save` | 保存到明确的 `.cdr` 路径 |
| `corel_export` | 导出 PNG、SVG 或 PDF |

操作坐标是页面左上角起算的毫米，文字字号是点。`corel_apply` 和 `corel_undo` 要带最近一次检查返回的 `expected_revision` 和 `snapshot_token`。一个批次最多100项，检查最多5000个图形，支持组内递归。保存及导出使用绝对路径，覆盖已有文件需要 `overwrite:true`。

```json
{
  "document_id": "从检查结果复制",
  "expected_revision": 0,
  "snapshot_token": "从检查结果复制",
  "label": "创建示例矩形",
  "operations": [
    { "op": "rectangle", "x": 10, "y": 10, "width": 30, "height": 20, "rgb": [35, 120, 210] }
  ]
}
```

默认观察及控制均通过 Harness 审批。配置 `observeApproval` / `controlApproval` 接受 `ask`、`allow`、`deny`；正式 Full access 权限预设可免除 `ask`，显式 `deny` 始终有效。

## 行为限制

批次使用 CorelDRAW 撤销组，异常时尝试回滚，不能承诺数据库式原子性。COM 调用一旦发出无法可靠取消；超时或取消返回结果未知时，原任务可能继续完成，后续请求仍串行等待，绝不自动重试写操作。应先检查文档再决定下一步。

快照令牌覆盖当前页读回的几何、文字及部分填充属性，不能检测所有字体、轮廓、PowerClip或其他页面的人工变化。执行期间请避免手工同时编辑。`corel_undo` 撤销的是该文档最新命令，可能包含人工操作，并非按插件历史定向回滚。PDF 使用文档现有发布设置；当前不提供印前配置管理。断开桥接不会主动调用 CorelDRAW 的 `Quit()`。

## 开发与验证

```powershell
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm test
pnpm doctor
pnpm smoke:discovery
pnpm smoke:corel
```

`doctor` 不连接 CorelDRAW，验证编译、STA串行、依赖文件及环境变量隔离。`smoke:corel` 明确启动或连接 CorelDRAW，新建独立测试文档，验证中文文字、几何、令牌冲突、撤销及CDR/PNG/SVG/PDF输出；测试文档保留在软件中，文件写入 `artifacts/` 下的新目录。

`smoke:discovery` 对已打开文档做只读检查，验证多实例选择、失效实例标识拒绝、失败选择后原连接仍有效以及发现过程没有启动新实例。可用 `CORELDRAW_TEST_PID` 指定目标，`CORELDRAW_DISCOVERY_REPORT` 保存结果。`pnpm instances` 输出当前执行环境的发现诊断。

使用真实 Electron 而非普通 Node 替代测试：

```powershell
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1'
Start-Process -Wait -FilePath 'C:\path\to\DeepSeek Harness.exe' `
  -ArgumentList @('C:\path\to\dsh-coreldraw\scripts\doctor.mjs') `
  -RedirectStandardOutput '.\electron-stdout.log' `
  -RedirectStandardError '.\electron-stderr.log'
```

必须看到 `DSH_CORELDRAW_DOCTOR_COMPLETE`；只看 GUI 可执行文件退出码不足以证明成功。可设置 `CORELDRAW_DOCTOR_REPORT` 为唯一输出路径，完成后写入含实际运行时的 JSON 凭证。

设计参考：[dsh-computer-use](https://github.com/leolee9086/dsh-computer-use) 的运行时分流及配套编译器文件处理；[corel-mcp](https://github.com/CubicDev1/corel-mcp) 的 COM 接入思路。本插件独立实现，CorelDRAW版本差异以真实读回为准。

decision.reason: Held for versioned DSH compatibility, public installation mapping. MIT native source has revision-token and allow/ask/deny concepts, but public install identity and versioned DSH compatibility remain unresolved. Uses C# STA/COM native helper operations affecting local documents; those helpers were not built or run. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.
